thar pa'i sa bon ma thebs pa dang / dge ba ma bskyed pa mang du yod pa las khong du chud par bya'o/ /rang bzhin gyi rigs chad pa mi srid pa ni gzhung de nyid du/ de bzhin nyid de thams cad la/ khyad par med kyang dag gyur pa/ /de bzhin gshegs nyid de yi phyir/ /'gro kun de yi snying po can/ /zhes pa la sogs pas rgyas par gsungs so/ /gzhan yang de nyid du/ de bzhin nyid dmigs ye shes dang / /gnyis su 'dzin pa rnam spangs dang / /gnas ngan len lus mngon sum pa/ /blo ldan de zad byed par 'dod/ /ces pa'i 'grel par/ 'dis ni ngo bo nyid gsum ji ltar yongs su shes pas gzhan gyi dbang gi ngo bo nyid zad par 'gyur ba de yongs su bstan te/ de bzhin nyid la dmigs pa nyid kyis yongs su grub pa'i ngo bo nyid yongs su shes pa dang /gnyis su 'dzin pa rnam par spangs pa nyid kyis kun btags pa dang /gnas ngan len gyi lus mngon sum pa nyid kyis gzhan gyi dbang yongs su shes nas gnas ngan len gyi lus kun gzhi rnam par shes pa gzhan gyi dbang de nyid zad par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzhan dbang zad pa dang kun gzhi rnam shes zad pa ni sems tsam las yang dag par 'das pa yin no/ /de lta bas na/ sems tsam pa rigs chad 'dod kyi dbu ma pa mi 'dod ces pa dang / sems tsam pa theg gcig drang don du 'dod ces pa dang / ngo bo nyid gsum sems tsam pa kho na'i chos skad yin ces pa dang / kun gzhi rnam shes la sogs pa rnam shes tshogs brgyad ston pas sems tsam nyid du grub ces pa la sogs par grags pa ngan pas khyab pa la ni shes byed rnam dag cung zad kyang mi snang zhing / gnod byed chen po shin tu mang bar 'dug pas dug bzhin du dor bar bya ste de dag ni sems 'grel gyi man ngag zab mo dang ma mjal bas sems tsam la bden gnyis su 'byed ma shes pa dang / gzhung 'ga' zhig gi 'bru ma non pa la brten nas 'khrul zhing 'khrul ba'i phyir ro/ /171

de bzhin du rgyud sde zab mo gzhan dang gzhan rnams su sems chen po dang /rdo rje'i sems dang / byang chub kyi sems dang / bde ba'i sems dang /chags pa chen po dang / zhe sdang chen po dang / gti mug chen po dang /sems dang sems byung gzhan dang / rnam shes gzhan la sogs pa rnam pa mang po'i sgo nas don dam pa'i sems nyid yang dang yang du gsungs shing /de la gzhan pa'i chos 'ga' yang gshis kyi gnas lugs la med pa'i phyir/chos kyi dbyings las ma gtogs pa'i chos 'ga' yang med par gsungs pa rnams dang don gcig pa yin no/ /de'i phyir gnas skabs su sems tsam ston yang / mthar thug de las 'das pa dbu ma chen po'i don zab cing rgya che ba ston pa'i gzhung lugs khyad par du 'phags pa rnams sems tsam gyi rang gzhung du phab na dam pa'i chos spong ba'i las su 'gyur ro/ /gal te gnas skabs su sems tsam ston pa nyid kyis sems tsam gyi gzhung du grub po snyam na/ de lta na ni rigs pa mtshungs pas yum dang mngon rtogs rgyan la sogs par yang / nyan thos kyi theg pa ston pa'i phyir/ de dag nyan thos kyi gzhung du 'gyur ram ci/ de lta bas na/ dgongs pa nges pa 'grel pa la sogs pa 'khor lo gsum pa'i mdo sde zab mo rnams dang /mdo sde'i rgyan dang / dbus mtha' rnam 'byed la sogs pa dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa dang / theg pa chen po bsdus pa dang / chos mngon pa kun las btus pa la sogs pa gnas skabs su sems tsam ston yang mthar de las shin tu 'das pa dbu ma chen po gsang sngags dang gcig pa'i don ston pa rnams la skur ba gdabs par mi bya'o/ /gal te sa sde ni/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa zhes pa bstan bcos kyi ming de nyid kyis sems tsam du grub po zhe na/de lta na ni rnal 'byor spyod pa bzhi brgya pa yang sems tsam gyi gzhung du ha cang thal bar 'gyur ro/ /sa'i dngos gzhir/ gang zag la bdag med pa dang /172

chos la bdag med pa dang / mtha' gnyis rnam par spangs pa'i dbu ma'i lam ste/ sgro btags pa'i mtha' rnam par spangs pa dang / skur pa btab pa'i mtha' rnam par spangs pa/ zhes sogs mtha' bral dbu ma yang yang gsungs pa rnams kyang mthong zhing rtogs par gyur cig / sum cu pa'i rab tu byed pa yang sems tsam gyi gzhung nyid du grags mod kyi/ nam zhig shes pa'i dmigs pa rnams/ /mi dmigs de yi tshe na ni/ /rnam par rig pa tsam la gnas/ /zhes pa'i mthar rnam rig tsam las 'das par gsungs te/ 'di ltar de'i rjes thogs nyid du/ / gzung ba med pas de 'dzin med/ / de ni sems med mi dmigs pa/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i ye shes te/ / gnas ni gzhan du gyur pa ste/ /gnas ngan len gnyis spangs pas so/ /de nyid zag pa med dang dbyings/ /bsam mi khyab dang dge dang brtan/ /de ni bde ba rnam grol sku/ /thub pa chen po'i chos zhes bya/ /zhes pa'o/ /'dir sems med mi dmigs pa zhes pa yang sems tsam pa sems rnam shes don dam du yod par 'dod pa dang 'gal zhing / zag pa med pa'i dbyings dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings dang / don dam pa'i dge ba dang / chos nyid mi 'gyur zhing brtan pa dang / don dam gnas lugs la bde ba dang /gdod nas rnam par grol ba'i sku dang / thub pa chen po'i chos sku dang dbyer med pa'i yon tan gyi chos gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed las 'das pa rnams kyang rnam shes kyi chos las shin tu 'das pa'i phyir sems tsam pa rnam shes don dam du bden par 'dod pa dang 'gal ba yin no/ /de bzhin du/ grub ni de la snga ma bo/ / rtag tu med par gyur pa gang / /zhes pa la sogs pas chos nyid yongs grub de bzhin nyid gsungs pa yang gnyis med ye shes yin pa nyid kyi phyir/ rnam shes kyi chos las yang dag par 'das pa yin no/ /de lta bas na gzhung 'dir sims tsam ston mod kyi/ mthar ni de las shin tu 'das pa 173

ston pa'i phyir/ sems tsam gyi rang gzhung nyid du phab na rtsom pa po'i dgongs pa dang mi mthun no/ /gzhan yang rnam shes kyi chos las 'das pa'i ye shes dang sangs rgyas dang chos kyi sku dang ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang de bzhin nyid la sogs pa legs par ston na sems tsam pa'i lugs las 'das par gyur te/dpal ldan dri ma dang bral ba'i 'od du/ 'dir rnam par shes par smra ba rnams kyi nang na ye shes kyi sku nyin mor byed pa'i sku yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su gyur pa ni 'ga' yang med do/ /'dir ci'i phyir rnam par shes par smra ba su rnams kyi nang na ye shes kyi sku nyin mor byed pa'i sku yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su gyur pa 'ga' yang med ce na/ brjod par bya ste 'dir rnam par shes par smra ba rnams rnam par shes pa'i chos la gnas pa'i phyir dang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid las 'das pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang de bzhin gshegs pas mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i so sor rtog pa'i ye shes la bstod par tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa gsum par gsungs pa 'di lta ste/ rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid 'das/ / gnyis med ye shes tshul 'chang ba/ / rnam par rtog med lhun gyis grub/ / dus gsum sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba/ / zhes so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang bdag gnyis kyis stong pa dang gzung 'dzin dang bral bar gsungs pa rnams kyang sems tsam las 'das par 'gyur te/ dpal ldan dri ma med pa'i 'od du/ da ni rnal 'byor spyod pa rnams kyi 'dzin pa'i skyon gsungs pa/ /srid gsum mtha' dag rnam par shes pa nyid du smra ba po yang rnam par shes pa 'dod par byed/ /ces dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa pa rnams la yang rnam par shes pa'i 'dzin pa yod de zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang 'dzin pa yod na chos kyi bdag dang bral bar mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa rgyud sde zab mo rnams sems tsam las ma 174

'das par 'dod pa yang shin tu mi rigs te/ dpal ldan dri ma med pa'i 'od du/ rnam shes de yang don dam du/ yod par mkhas rnams mi 'dod de/ / gcig dang du ma'i rang bzhin dang / / bral bas nam mkha'i pad ma bzhin/ / yod min med min yod med min/ / gnyis ga'i bdag nyid min pa'ang min/ / mtha' bzhi rnam par grol ba yi/ / de nyid dbu ma pa yis rig /ces dang / de'i phyir gcig dang du ma dag kyang gcig cing mnyam dang mi mnyam pa yang mnyam pa/ zhes pa la sogs pas dbu ma pa'i grub pa'i mtha' 'o/ /zhes pa la sogs pas sems tsam las 'das pa'i chos zab cing rgya che ba du ma gsungs pa'i phyir dang / dus 'khor la sogs pa'i rgyud dang sngags dang lha dang dkyil 'khor mthar thug pa thams cad sems dang yid dang rnam shes las 'das pa'i rang byung ye shes yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de lta bas na sems tsam las yang dag par 'das pa'i gsung rab zab mo rnams la skur ba gdabs par mi bya ste/ chos spong gi las chen por 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de nyid kyi phyir na gnas lugs la yod med dang rang stong gzhan stong dang med dgag ma yin dgag dang rnam gcod dang yongs gcod dang spangs pa dang ye shes dang stong pa'i stong pa dang / mi stong pa'i stong pa dang gang med cing de'i lhag ma gang yin pa la sogs pa legs par rnam par phye ba 'di yang sems 'grel rnams kyis legs par gsal bar byas pa'i 'khor lo tha ma dang rgyud sde zab mo'i man ngag thun mong ma yin pa dang ldan pa las gsal bar 'gyur zhing de dag dang ldan na 'khor lo bar ba'i don yang rab tu gsal bar 'gyur te/ ri bo chen po dag la steng gi nam mkha' mthon po nas lta ba bzhin no/ / de dag dang bral na ni rang stong las lhag pa'i stong nyid dang /dag pa'i bdag dang 'dus ma byas kyi ye shes dang dbyings rig dbyer med dang gzhi 'bras dbyer med la sogs pa mi srid cing bde gshegs snying po drang 175

don yin pas don la med ces pa la sogs pa lta ngan gyi phreng ba du mar 'gyur bas lta ba'i snyigs ma bdo bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir lta ba ngan pa thams cad spang bar 'dod pa dang yang dag pa'i lta ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par 'dod pa dang / dgongs te gsungs pa'am dgongs pa chen po'i don mthong bar 'dod pa dang / de kho na nyid kyi don mthong bar 'dod pas rang stong gzhan stong la sogs pa'i khyad par legs par gtan la phab nas phyin ci ma log pa'i nges pa rnyed par bya dgos te/ de yang / rgyal ba byams pa'i zhal snga nas/ stong pa nyid ni mdor bsdu na/ /de bzhin nyid dang yang dag mtha'/ /mtshan ma med dang don dam dang / /chos kyi dbyings ni rnam grangs so/ /gzhan min phyin ci log ma yin/ / de 'gags 'phags pa'i spyod yul dang / /'phags pa'i chos kyi rgyu yi phyir/ rnam grangs don de go rim bzhin/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas kyang / byang chub sems mchog de nyid ni/ /de bzhin nyid dang yang dag mtha'/ /mtshan ma med dang don dam dang / / stong pa nyid ces bshad pa yin/ / zhes dang /mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas stong phrag bcu gnyis par yang / e gsang mkha' khams bha ga'am/ / chos 'byung chu skyes seng ge'i khrir/ / zhes dang /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug gi zhal snga nas kyang / de bzhin du e yig dang / gsang ba dang pad ma dang chos 'byung dang nam mkha'i dbyings dang bde ba chen po'i gnas dang seng ge'i khri dang / bha ga dang gsang ba'i ming rnams kyi nang nas e yig gcig pu gtso bo'i ming ma yin te thams cad kyis rnam pa thams cad pa'i stong pa nyid go bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ gcig la rnam pa thams cad tshang ba ni kun rdzob kyi chos gang la yang mi srid do/ /de lta bas na e yig la sogs pa'i rnam grangs du ma can don gcig nyid rnam pa thams cad pa'i stong pa nyid ni don dam stong 176

nyid yin gyi kun rdzob stong nyid yin mi srid do/ /gal te de bzhin nyid la sogs pa rnam grangs du ma can du gsungs pa'i stong nyid ni/ chos thams cad rang rang ngo bos stong pa'i rang stong kho na'o zhe na/ de lta na ni 'o na log sred can gtan yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' pa'i chos can zhes gsungs pa gang yin pa de yang / de bzhin nyid yin par 'gyur te/ rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod na de yang sangs rgyas yin par 'gyur te de bzhin nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di la khyab pa med snyam du bsam par mi bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po bstan pa'i mdor/ de bzhin nyid kyi don gang yin pa de de bzhin gshegs pa'i don to/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba byams pa'i zhal snga nas kyang / de bzhin nyid ni sangs rgyas 'dod/ /ces dang / yum rgyas par yang / rab 'byor yang dag pa'i don ni sangs rgyas shes bya ste/ zhes dang / de'i 'grel par yang /yang dag pa'i don de bzhin nyid chos kyi sku la sangs rgyas zhes bya pa'i tha tshig go /zhes dang / sher phyin bdun brgya ba'i 'grel pa slob dpon bi ma la mi dras mdzad par yang / chos kyi dbyings nyid bcom ldan 'das yin te/zhes dang / chos kyi dbyings de nyid byang chub po zhes mdo drangs shing /'phags pa brgyad stong par yang / de bzhin nyid la ni 'ong ba'am 'gro ba med de de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o zhes pa la sogs pa de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de sangs rgyas yin par ston pa'i lung rnam dag shin tu mang ba'i phyir ro/ / gzhan yang de dang de rnam grangs yin na gzhan dang gzhan du 'gyur pa'i dngos po glo bur pa rnams kyang de bzhin nyid yin par 'gyur te rang rang ngo bas stong pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de 'dod na gzhan dang gzhan du mi 'gyur pa yin par ha cang thal te/ 'phags pa thogs med kyi zhal snga nas kyang / ci'i phyir de bzhin nyid la de bzhin nyid 177

ces bya zhe na/ gzhan du mi 'gyur pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /zhes dang / rgyal ba byams pa'i zhal snga nas kyang / gzhan min zhes de bzhin nyid kyi don gzhan du mi 'gyur ba la gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang mi dge ba rnams kyang rang stong yin pa'i phyir de bzhin nyid yin par 'gyur la/ 'dod na/ de dge ba yin par 'gyur te/ don dam pa'i dge ba dang yod pa'i dge ba dang 'dus ma byas pa'i dge ba yin pa'i phyir te/ de bzhin nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rtags 'di khas blangs shing de bzhin nyid yin na don dam pa'i dge ba dang yod pa'i dge ba dang 'dus ma byas kyi dge ba yin par lung rnam dag rnams su yang yang gsungs pas de la de dang des khyab pa yang yod do/ /de lta bas na dngos pos 'gyur pa'i chos can gang yin pa rnams stong nyid yin yang de bzhin nyid ma yin no/ /de bzhin nyid gang yin pa de stong nyid yin yang rang stong ma yin zhing rang gis rang mi rig pa'i stong nyid kyang ma yin no/ /de bzhin du yang dag pa'i mtha' la sogs pa gzhan rnams kyang rang stong dang rnam grangs ma yin pa nyid du rig par bya'o/ /gal te rang stong dang yang dag pa'i mtha' rnam grangs yin na phyin ci log gang yin pa rnams kyang yang dag pa'i mtha' yin par 'gyur la/ de 'dod na phyin ci ma log pa yin par 'gyur te/ rgyal ba byams pa'i zhal snga nas/ phyin ci log ma yin/ zhes yang dag pa'i mtha'i don phyin ci ma log pa'i mthar thug pa la gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ / de bzhin du rang stong dang / mtshan ma med pa'i dbyings rnam grangs su 'dod na/ mtshan ma ma 'gags pa'i dngos po rnams kyang rang stong yin pa'i phyir mtshan ma med pa'i dbyings yin par 'gyur la/ de 'dod na/ mtshan ma 'gags pa yin par 'gyur te/ rje btsun byams pa'i zhal snga nas/ de 'gags zhes mtshan ma med pa'i dbyings kyi don mtshan ma de 'gags pa'i gzhi la gsungs pa'i phyir dang / 'phags pa thogs med kyi 178

zhal snga nas kyang / ci'i phyir mtshan ma med pa zhes bya zhe na/ mtshan ma nye bar zhi ba'i phyir/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du rang stong dang don dam pa'i bden pa rnam grangs su 'dod na/ sgrib pa gnyis kyang rang stong yin pa'i phyir don dam pa'i bden par 'gyur la/ 'dod na de gnyen po gang gis kyang spang du mi rung bar 'gyur zhing / 'phags pa'i ye shes dam pa'i rang rig gi spyod yul yang yin par 'gyur te/ dpal mgon byams pa'i zhal snga nas/ 'phags pa'i spyod yul dang / zhes pa dang /'phags pa thogs med zhabs kyis kyang / ci'i phyir don dam pa zhes bya zhe na/'phags pa'i ye shes dam pa'i spyod yul yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du rang stong dang chos kyi dbyings rnam grangs su 'dod na/ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa mi bzad pa rnams kyang rang stong yin pa'i phyir/ chos kyi dbyings yin par 'gyur la/ 'dod na de 'phags pa'i chos rnams kyi rgyu yin par 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ 'phags pa'i chos kyi rgyu yi phyir/ /zhes dang / ci'i phyir chos kyi dbyings zhes bya zhe na/nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang / don dam byang chub kyi sems dang / stong pa nyid la sogs pa rnam grangs su gsungs pa'i stong nyid de/ rang stong la dgongs pa yin na/ don dam byang chub kyi sems ma yin pa sdig pa mi bzad pa'i sems gang yin pa rnams kyang rang stong yin pa'i phyir don dam byang chub kyi sems yin par ha cang thal bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te sdig pa la sogs pa'i dngos pos sngar smos pa de rnams kyi sto/nga pa'i cha gang yin pa de don dam byang chub kyi sems dang chos kyi dbyings la sogs pa'i rnam grangs yin la snang ba'i cha gang yin pa de de lta ma yin pas skyon de dag med do snyam na/ de lta na ni snang ba'i cha de stong ngam mi stong / gal te stong na ni de 179

yang de bzhin nyid la sogs pa yin par 'gyur la/ mi stong pa'i dngos po ni mi srid de/ kun rdzob stong pa nyid du bshad/ /stong nyid kho na kun rjob ste/ /byas dang mi rtag pa bzhin du/ / med na mi 'byung des phyir ro/ / zhes dang /gzugs stong pa'o stong pa nyid gzugs so/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshul dang rigs pas snang ba stong pa nyid do/ /stong pa nyid snang ba'o/ /de las de gzhan ma yin zhing / de las kyang de gzhan ma yin no/ /zhes pa'i don du 'gyur pa'i phyir/ 'di ni shin tu mi rigs pa kho na'o/ /de bzhin du mi dge ba'i stong pa'i cha/ de bzhin nyid dang rnam grangs su 'dod na yang / de dge ba yin dgos pas/ 'dir snang ba'i cha mi dge ba dang / stong pa'i cha dge ba yin par khas blang dgos par yang 'gyur zhing / mi stong pa'i snang cha mi srid pas mi dge ba'i snang cha yang rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i phyir de bzhin nyid dang dge ba yin par ha cang thal bar 'gyur te/ 'phags pa thogs med zhabs kyi zhal snga nas/ don dam pa'i dge ba gang zhe na/ de bzhin nyid do zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang mthar thug gi bha ga la sogs pa stong nyid kyi rnam grangs mang po gsungs pa rnams kyang stong gzhi don dam gzhan stong gi rnam grangs su dgongs pa yin gyi rang stong gi ni ma yin no/ / gal te rang stong dang rnam grangs yin na kun mkhyen gyi yon tan ma tshang ba'i glo bur dri ma mi bzad pa rnams kyang mthar thug gi bha ga yin par 'gyur la/ 'dod na de/ dbang phyug la sogs pa'i yon tan tshang ba'i sangs rgyas rin chen za ma tog yin par 'gyur te/ phyag rgya chen po'i thig le'i rgyud du/ ji ltar til son til mar dang / / ji ltar shing la gnas pa'i me/ / de bzhin chos rnams thams cad la/ /yang dag gnas kyang mi mthong ba/ /chos kyi dbyings ni bha gar bshad/ /bha ga rin chen za ma tog / gang phyir dbang phyug sogs yon tan/ /ldan pa 180

de phyir bha gar bshad/ /chos ni bha ga zhes byar grags/ /dbyings ni sems su shes par dran/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'dis ni chos thams cad la gnas pa'i chos nyid bde gshegs snying po bha ga don dam byang chub sems su sasungs par yang rig par bya'o/ /gzhan yang sems can ngan pa sdig po che rnams kyang rang stong yin pa'i phyir mthar thug gi bha ga yin par 'dod dgos pas de'i yon tan thams cad tshang bar ha cang thal bar 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ 'dod pa'i 'dod chags gcod byed cing / /nyon mongs rnams bcom gzhan mi thub/ / de phyir de ni bha gar brjod/ / ces nā ros 'grel chen du drangs pa'i phyir dang / dbang phyug dang ni gzugs bzang dang / / dpal dang grags dang ye shes dang / / brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa ste/ / drug rnams bha ga zhes par bshad/ /sum bcu rtsa drug khams dag pa/ /sa sogs rdo rje btsun mo rnams/ /de yi yon tan dbang phyug sogs/ /drug po de rnams bha gar bsgrags/ /zhes rtsa rgyud mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas su gsungs pa'i yang phyir ro/ / de bzhin du/ dpal kye'i rdo rje'i lung slob dpon a tsa la garbhas bshad sbyar du drangs pa yang / 'joms byed bha ga zhes bya ste/ /bdud dang nyon mongs dgra 'joms phyir/ /shes rab kyis gzhom nyon mongs te/ /de phyir shes rab bha gar brjod/ / ces bdud dang nyon mongs pa las gdod nas rang bzhin gyis rgyal ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma bha gar gsungs pa dang / dpal rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud du yang / nyon mongs las dang de bzhin skye/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib de bzhin/ /mi mthun phyogs kyi chos gang bcom/ /de ni bha ga ldan zhes bshad/ /ces mi mthun phyogs kun gdod nas rang bzhin gyis bcom pa'i gzhi la bha gar gsungs pa dang / dpal kye'i rdo rjer yang / sangs rgyas 'di la bha ga mnga'/ / bcom ldan zhes ni brjod par bya/ /bha ga rnam pa drug tu brjod/ /dbang phyug la sogs yon tan 181

kun/ / yang na nyon mongs la sogs bdud/ / 'dzoms phyir bha ga ldan zhes brjod/ / ces rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i yon tan dang spangs pa mthar thug pa'i sangs rgyas la bha gar gsungs pa dang / dpal rjo rje phreng ba'i rgyud du yang / chos dbyings bha ga zhes ni bshad/ / bha ga rin chen za ma tog /gang phyir dbang phyug sogs yon tan/ /ldan pa de phyir bha gar brjod/ bha ga chos rnams kun tu ni/ / dbyings ni byang chub sems su gsungs/ / zhes don dam pa'i yon tan gyi chos kun tshang ba'i dbyings rigs dbyer med byang chub kyi sems la bha gar gsungs pa dang / dgongs pa lung ston pa'i rgyud du yang / sangs rgyas kun gyis gang bsten pa/ / bcu gsum pa yi sar gyur gang / / de ni btsun mor yang dag bshad/ /dam chos bha ga zhes pa yang / /zhes bden don bcu gnyis ldan pa'i gzhi don dam pa'i chos sangs rgyas kun gyi btsun mo la bha gar gsungs pa dang / dpal sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud du yang / mchog gi ye shes ji bzhin pa/ / bha ga'i dbus na rnam par bzhugs/ /bde ba chen po ster byed pa/ /'di nyid du ni kun gnas kyang / /byis pa rmongs pas mi shes so/ /zhes 'gyur med mchog gi bde ba ster zhing /de'i bzhugs gnas su gyur pa'i dbyings la bha gar gsungs pa dang /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud du yang / gong bu dgug pa pad ma nyid/ /bha ga'i nang du nges chud pa/ /ye shes rgya mtsho bsam par bya/ /zhes bde ba'i ye shes kyi gong bu 'gugs pa don dam gzhan stong gi pad ma la bha gar gsungs pa dang / gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa sgron gsal du drangs pa yang / btsun mo legs sbyangs phyag rgya ste/ /bha ga legs sbyangs pad ma'o/ /zhes sangs rgyas kun gyi btsun mo phyag rgya chen mo la bha ga dang pad mar gsungs pa dang /dpal phyag na rdo rjes 'khor lo sdom pa'i 'grel par drangs pa yang / dbang phyug la sogs yon tan ldan/ / bha ga yang na bdud bcom phyir/ /gang la de 182

mnga'i phyir na 'di/ / bcom ldan khams gsum dbang phyug gsungs/ / zhes spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mthar thug par rang bzhin gyis tshang ba'i dbyingaru/ rig dbyer med la bha gar gsungs shing / bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug gi zhal snga/ nas kyang / bha ga wa na 'chad pa'i skabs su/ bcom ldan ni bdud dang nyon mongs pa bcom pa'i phyir bcom pa'am/dbang phyug la sogs pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs kyi skal ba ste/de 'di la ldan pa'i phyir bcom ldan no/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'dir bha ga wa na zhes pa bcom ldan du 'gyur ba ltar skal ldan du yang 'gyur pas skad sor bzhag nyid la bshad na 'grig cing legs pa yin no/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi rgyal por yang / gcig dang du ma dag kyang gcig cing mnyam dang mi mnyam pa yang mnyam pa g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab dang / / steng 'og kun nas dkar ljang sna tshogs kha dog chen po gcig gi gzugs te thung ngu ring po dang / /shin tu ring po yon tan med ces yon tan dang bcas bud med skyes pa'ang skyes pa bud med min/ /gang zhig kun gyi rten gcig bha ga bzang mo mchog gi bha ga khyod la 'dud de khyod la 'dud/ /ces dang / de'i 'grel par yang / bha ga bzang mo zhes pa ni/ dbang phyug la sogs pa'i yon tan gyi bdag nyid do/ /mchog gi bha ga ni khams gsum gyi mchog go / rgyu des na mgo bos 'dud pa ste/ /zhes dang / mngon par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i bla mar yang / dam tshig gsang gsum sbyor ba yis/ / bha ga'i dbus su bsgom par bya/ / zhes dang / bha gar rdo rje phag mo ni/ / gsang ba gsum du rnam par bsgom/ /zhes dang / dkyil 'khor bha ga yin par bshad/ /ces pa la sogs pas dbu ma chen po'i gsung rab zab mo mthar thug pa shin tu mang po rnams su dbang phyug la sogs pa chos nyid kyi yon tan rang bzhin gyis yongs su grub pa mtha' yas pa'i bdag nyid don dam pa'i lha dang sngags dang phyag rgya 183

dang rgyud dang dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i ming du ma can stong gzhi de bzhin nyid la bha gar gsungs pa rab tu mang bar bzhugs pas rgyas par de rnams su blta bar bya'o/ /gzhan yang / rgyud sde rin po che rnam par dag pa rnams su stong nyid rdo rjer gsungs pa rnams kyang stong gzhi don dam gzhan stong nyid la dgongs kyi/rang stong la ni ma yin no/ /gal te rang stong gis rdo rje de'i go chod par 'dod na/ snyi ba dang snying po ma yin pa dang khong stong can dang gcad du yod cing dbyer yod pa dang 'tshig pa dang 'jig pa'i dngos po ngan pa sab sub dang ljan ljin dang lud khung la sogs pa mi gtsang ba'i rdzas rnams kyang rang rang ngo bos stong pa'i phyir mthar thug gi rdo rje yin par 'gyur la/ 'dod na de rnams sra ba dang snying po yin pa dang khong stong med pa la sogs par 'dod dgos te/ dpal rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud du/ rdo rje rdo rje zhes gsungs pa/ /cis 'di rdo rjer brjod ce na/ /sra zhing snying po khog stong med/ /gcad med dbyer med mtshan nyid can/ /mi 'tshig 'jig pa ma yin pa/ /stong nyid rdo rjer brjod par bya/ / zhes dang / bden zhing don yod de bzhin nyid/ /'gyur ba med cing skye ba med/ /'gag med de kho na nyid gang / /de lta bu ni rdo rje yin/ /zhes dang / 'gyur ba med pa de bzhin nyid/ /chos kyi dbyings ni brtan pa gang / /de lta bu ni 'dir rdo rje/ /zhes dang / 'gro drug 'khor lo nyes byas kyang / /rdo rje yis ni 'joms par byed/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /nyon mongs thams cad 'joms par byed/ / ces dang / chos rnams kun gyi de bzhin nyid/ /stong pa nyid ni rdo rjer brjod/ /ces pa la sogs pa dang / dpal rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud du yang / mi chod mi phyed mi 'gyur pa/ /mi tshig pa dang mchog tu 'bigs/ /sangs rgyas ye shes lnga yi mchog / rang bzhin rdo rje zhes ni brjod/ /ces dang / zhi ba gnyis med rnam pa bral/ /184

dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin bdag / bde chen zhes ni 'di la brjod/ /rdo rje ye shes lnga'i dngos nyid/ / sangs rgyas lnga bdag rang bzhin can/ / zhes sogs dang / dpal thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud du yang / rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal ba'i/ / sems ni rdo rjer mngon brjod bya/ / zhes dang /dpal dus kyi 'khor lor yang / rdo rje dag kyang ye shes sku chen rnam par mi phyed pa'o/ /zhes sogs dang / dpal kye'i rdo rje dang / dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs pa rgyud sde mang po rnams su yang / mi phyed rdo rje zhes byar brjod/ /zhes sogs dang / 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi 'al snga nas kyang / rdo rje zhes pa ni mi phyed pa'i ye shes bsam du med pa'i thugs rdo rje'o/ /de gang la yod pa de ni rdo rje can te/ /zhes dang / rdo rje ni mi phyed pa dang mi chod pa chen po yin la de nyid theg pa yin pa ni rdo rje theg pa ste sngags kyi tshul dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'bras bu dang rgyu'i bdag nyid gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa'o/ / zhes dang / rdo rje theg pa ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ste mu stegs pa dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa rnams kyis mi phyed pa'i phyir rdo rje ste thar par 'dis 'gro ba'i phyir rdo rje theg pa'o/ /zhes sogs dang / rdo rje rnam 'joms su yang / mi chod pa mi shigs pa bden pa sra ba brtan pa thams cad du thogs pa med pa zhes pa la sogs pa rnams kyis/ gang gis kyang mi chod cing mi shigs pa'i dbyings bden pa yang dag pa sra zhing brtan pa skye 'gag 'pho 'gyur med pa'i de bzhin nyid rang byung ye shes lnga dang sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid rang bzhin 'od gsal byang chub kyi sems gang yin pa de la rdo rjer gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /don dam pa'i mtshan brjod du yang / gtsig bu sra 'khregs rdo rje'i bdag /ces dang / rdo rje shugs btsan 'jigs byed pa/ /rdo rje'i grags pa rdo rje'i snying / / sgyu 'phrul rdo rje gsus po che/ / rdo rje las skyes rdo rje'i 185

bdag /rdo rje snying po mkha' 'dra ba/ / zhes dang / rdo rje gad mo cher sgrogs pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje rgyal po bde ba che/ /rdo rje drag po dga' ba che/ / rdo rje hūṃ ste hūṃ zhes sgrogs/ / mtshon du rdo rje'i mda' thogs pa/ / rdo rje ral gri ma lus gcod/ / rdo rje kun 'chang rdo rje can/ / rdo rje gcig pu g.yul sel ba/ / rdo rje 'bar ba mig mi bzad/ / skra yang rdo rje 'bar ba ste/ /rdo rje 'bebs pa 'bebs pa che/ /mig brgya pa ste rdo rje'i mig /lus ni rdo rje'i ba spu can/ /rdo rje'i spu ni gcig pu'i lus/ /sen mo skyes pa rdo rje'i rtse/ / rdo rje snying po lpags pa mkhregs/ /rdo rje phreng thogs dpal dang ldan/ /rdo rje'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa ste/ /zhes dang / yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgra/ / zhes dang / rdo rje rin chen dbang bskur dpal/ /zhes dang / rdo rje 'chang ba kun gyi rje/ /zhes dang / rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che/ /rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od/ ces dang / rdo rje rnon po ral gri che/ /zhes dang / mtshon cha chen po rdo rje chos/ /rdo rje zab mo 'dzi na dzika / rdo rje blo gros don bzhin rig /ces dang / rdo rje'i gdan ni ma lus ldan/ /zhes pa la sogs pas don dam pa rang byung ye shes gcig pu sra 'khregs kyi shugs dang grags pa dang sgra dang gad mo dang sgyu 'phrul dang snying dang snying po dang bdag dang bde ba dang / dga' ba dang mig dang skra dang spu dang ba spu dang sen mo dang lpags pa dang gsus pa dang gdan dang phreng pa dang rgyan dang mda' dang ral gri la sogs pa mtshon cha rnams dang / dbang bskur dang 'bebs pa dang blo gros dang dpal dang nyi zla la sogs pa ga'an bde gshegs snying po'i rnam pa thams cad rdo rje nyid du gsungs shing / de bzhin du rkang pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis par yang / rdo rje 'jigs byed/ rdo rje'i tshogs/ rdo rje'i sku/ rdo rje'i spyan/ rdo rje'i snyan/ rdo rje'i shangs/ rdo rje'i ljags/ rdo rje'i tshoms/rdo rje'i sen mo/ rdo rje'i skra/ rdo rje'i ba spu/ rdo rje'i rgyan/ rdo rje'i 186

ba'ad pa/ rdo rje'i glu/ rdo rje'i gar/ rdo rje'i mtshon cha zhes pa la sogs pas don dam de bzhin nyid kyi thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa ye shes kyi lha'i skye mched dang / yan lag dang glu gar dang / mtshon cha la sogs pa thams cad rdo rje nyid du gsungs la/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i 'al snga nas kyang / chos dang lhan cig skyes pa'i sku 'di dag gcig pa nyid rdo rje sems dpa' zhes brjod par bya ste/ rdo rje zhes pa chos kyi sku dang stong pa nyid dang shes rab bo/ /sems dpa' zhes pa lhan cig skyes pa'i sku dang snying rje dang thabs so/ / de ltar shes rab dang thabs yang dag par sbyor ba'i bdag nyid ni rdo rje sems dpa' mngon par brjod par bya'o/ /zhes chos sku dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma yang yin la/ stong nyid kyang yin pa'i rdo rje gsungs pa 'di ni stong gzhi don dam gzhan stong dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid las 'os med pa nyid du yid ches par bya'o/ /de bzhin du ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud du yang / sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas/ /mi shes dri ma kun bcom pa/ /rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ /rdo rje rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin/ / rdo rje sku ste sku che ba/ / phyag na rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje yan lag rdo rje mchog /rdo rje 'bar ba cher 'bar ba/ /rdo rje shugs te shugs che ba/ /rdo rje mtshon cha mtshon cha che/ /phyag na rdo rje phyag chen po/ / rdo rje mda' ste rab 'bigs pa/ / rdo rje rnon po rno ba che/ / zhes pa la sogs pa nas thams cad rdo rje'i bdag nyid gtso/ /zhes pa'i mthar thug pa rnams kyis dbyings rig dbyer med rang byung ye shes kyi lha rnams rdo rjer gsungs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid 'dus par yang / rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ / rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang / /phyag 'tshal phyag na rdo rje la'o/ /rdo rje rgyal po sangs rgyas mchog / rdo rje lcags kyu de bzhin gshegs/ /nges pa'i 187

rgyal po rdo rje mchog / phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'gugs khyod la/ /rdo rje chags pa bde chen po/ /rdo rje mda' ni dbang byed pa/ /bdud kyi 'dod pa rdo rje che/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje gzhu khyod la/ /zhes pa la sogs pa nas/ rdo rje bsdams pa phyag rgya che/ / zhes pa la sogs pas kyang bde gshegs snying po yang dag pa'i mtha' dbang po thams cad pa dang rnam pa thams cad pa'i lha rnams thams cad rdo rjer gsungs so/ / dpal mchog dang po'i rgyud du yang / sku dang gsung dang thugs thams cad rdo rje zhes pa la sogs pa dang / rdo rje sra ba nyid kyi phyir rdo rje mnyam pa nyid mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa ni byang chub chen po'o/ /zhes pa la sogs pas byang chub chen po'i sku dang gsung dang thugs rnams rdo rjer gsungs shing / dpal rdo rje rtse mor yang / rdo rje dbyings ni shin tu brtan/ /de nyid ye shes mngon sangs rgyas/ /zhes shin tu brtan pa'i chos kyi dbyings nyid ye shes dang sangs rgyas dang rdo rjer gsungs so/ /dpal mchog dang po'i rgyud du yang / bde ba chen po rdo rje che/ /rdo rje kun gyis legs brgyan pa/ / zhes dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi gnas/ /bde ba chen po rdo rje che/ /zhes dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i chos nyid brnyes pa chos thams cad spros pa med pa yang bde ba chen po rdo rje don yod pa'i dam tshig ces bya ba rdo rje chos nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/ dpal mchog dang po/ thog ma dang tha ma dang dbus med pa'i dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /zhes spros pa med pa'i chos nyid bde ba chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rdo rjer gsungs shing / dpal dri ma med pa'i 'od du yang / stong pa chen po 'gyur med lnga ni sum cu rtsa drug gi bdag nyid rgyal ba rnams kyis rdo rjer gsungs te/ de 'dzin pa'i phyir rdo rje 'dzin pa'o zhes dbyings rig dbyer med don dam gyi phung po drug la sogs pa lha sum cu rtsa drug la rdo rjer gsungs 188

so/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpal 'dus par yang / de la mngon par shes pa ldan/ rdo rje'i spyan dang / rdo rje'i snyan dang / rdo rje'i thugs dang / rdo rje'i gnas dang / rdo rje'i rdzu 'phrul lo/ /zhes gsungs shing / de nyid kyi 'grel pa sgron ma gsal bar yang / rdo rje ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes te/ de'i ngo bo nyid kyis 'chang bar mdzad pas na rdo rje 'dzin pa ste mthar thug pa'o/ /zhes gsungs la de bzhin du/ rgyud dang rgyud gzhan shin tu mang por yang / sku rdo rje gsung rdo rje thugs rdo rje ye shes rdo rje zhes sogs dang / rdo rje'i 'du shes rdo rje'i 'du byed/ / ces sogs dang /rdo rje'i mig rdo rje'i gzugs zhes pa la sogs pa rdo rje'i skye mched rnams dang /rdo rje 'chang rdo rje bdud rtsi rdo rje'i dbyings rdo rje hūṃ mdzad rdo rje 'jigs byed rdo rje dbang phyug rdo rje mkha' 'gro rdo rje rtse mo rdo rje gdan pa'i/ zhes sogs dang / 'dod chags rdo rje/ zhe sdang rdo rje/ gti mug rdo rje/ phrag dog rdo rje zhes sogs dang / rdo rje ston rdo rje rgun (dgun ) zhes sogs dang /rdo rje'i theg pa/ rdo rje'i sngags/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor/ rdo rje phag mo/rdo rje sgrol ma/ rdo rje bdag med ma zhes pa la sogs pa thams cad chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos kyi gnas nyid dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor pa de bzhin nyid dang /gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings dang / ma skyes pa dang / ma 'gags pa dang /gzod ma nas zhi ba dang / rang bzhin gyis yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang / gzugs rnam par dag pa la sogs pa rnam dag le'u rgya cher gsungs pa dang chos nyid kyi gzugs la sogs pa dang / khams gsum dang dus gsum las 'das pa'i gzugs la sogs pa rnams dang don gcig pa kho na ste/kun rdzob kyi sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byang rung ma byang rung / gang zag ༄ ༄ 189

rnams kyis khungs chod rung ma chod rung / yid ches rung mi ches rung / glo bur dri ma 'gags rung ma 'gags rung mkha' ltar kun khyab tu nam yang bzhugs pa yin no/ / gzhan yang rang stong las gzhan pa'i stong nyid zab mo med par 'dod na gzhi 'bras ngo bo dbyer med kyi phyag rgya chen mo dang rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid dang / yum sher phyin yang med par 'gyur te/ rang stong gis de rnams kyi go mi chod pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te chod na dug dang bshang ba la sogs pa dngos po ngan pa rnams kyang de dang de yin par 'gyur te/ rang rang ngo bos stong pa'i phyir ro/ / 'dod par mi nus te/bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhal snga nas/ phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das/ / pra phab pa yi rang bzhin can/ / rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan ma/ /phyag rgya chen mo de la 'dud/ /ces dang / gang zhig phung po la sogs sgrib pa rab bcom yul ni pra phab brgyad lta bu/ / kun mkhyen bde ster de nyid gcig pu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya chen mo ste/ /zhes dang / phyag rgya chen mo ni rang bzhin med pa'i chos thams cad kyi mtshan nyid can rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa shes rab gyi pha rol tu phyin na sangs rgyas skyed par mdzad pa'o/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs shing / rgyud kyi rgyal por yang / phyag rgya sgyu ma'i rjes su mthun pa yid dang nam mkha' la ni me long dag 'a/ gzugs bzhin te/ /'jig rten gsum po snang bar byed cing dri med glog dang mtshungs pa'i 'od zer du ma 'phro bar byed/ / ces sogs dang /mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur du yang / nam mkha'i khams ni ji snyed par/ /'jig rten khams ni stong phrag na/ /bde chen phun tshogs phyag rgya che/ /sangs rgyas nam mkha' 'dra bar bzhugs/ /zhes dang / de nyid 'dus par yang /de bzhin gshegs pa phyag rgya che/ /zhes dang / phyag rgya chen po'i tshul du ni/ /190

ji ltar rdo rje 'dzin grub pa/ /zhes dang / gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i zhal snga nas kyang / dngos grub ni phyag rgya chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam pa thams cad kyi mtshog dang ldan pa'o zhes dang / phyag rgya chen po 'dod pa'i dngos grub de ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang lam mkhyen pa nyid dang lam gyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa bzhi la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mtha' dag ster bar byed pa mo ste zhes dang / nang du ni khams gsum ma lus pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan mthong ba ste phyag rgya chen po mthong ba dang / zhes dang / sgrib pa thams cad dang bral ba pra phab pa lta bu phyag rgya chen po sangs rgyas kyi 'od zer gyi sprin mtha' yas pa spro bar byed pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par spras pa zhes dang / don rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rang gi sems kyi snang ba tsam phyag rgya chen po rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong pa nyid dang de bzhin nyid dang /rigs ldan ma dang padma zhes brjod par bya'o zhes sogs dang / dpal kye'i rdo rje'i rgyud du yang / bo li'i bde ba phyag rgya che/ /rdo rje skye mched thams cad nyid/ /gsang ba'i snyoms 'jug 'di yis ni/ /phyi rol gnyis gnyis bstan pa med ces sogs dang / ga pur nyid ni bdag med ma/ / bde ba bdag med tshul can nyid/ /de yi bde ba phyag rgya che/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid du gnas/ /dang po'i dbyangs yig rang bzhin te/ /blo zhes sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags zhes dang / /de nyid bcom ldan shes rab ma/ /de ni ring min thung ba min/ /gru bzhi ma yin zlum po min/ /dri dang ro dang mya ngan 'das/ /lhan cig skyes dga' byed pa can/ /de las skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de yi bde ba za ba nyid/ /de dang lhan cig phyag rgya che/ /zhes sogs dang / yang de nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i gzugs/ /bde chen bzang po'i rnal 'byor ma/ /191

de nyid dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang / /ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can/ /de ni me long ye shes gzugs/ /mnyam nyid ye shes dngos po can/ /yang dag gyur pa so sor rtog / de nyid bya ba nan tan te/ /chos dbyings shin tu rnam dag pa/ / de nyid dkyil 'khor bdag po nga / / de nyid bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin can/ / zhes dang / / dngos grub mtshan nyid mi phyed pa/ /phyag rgya rnal 'byor ba yis 'grub zhes dang / rje nā ro paṇa chen gyi zhal snga nas kyang / sgyu ma la sogs dpe rnams kyis/ /gang gi ngo bo rtogs bya ba/ / phyag rgya chen mo de nyid la/ / kun tu gus pas bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes dang / thob bya zhes pa phyag rgya chem po ste/ /zhes pa la sogs pa rnams kyis chos kyi dbyings dang rang byung gi ye shes dbyer med gcig pa de nyid des don mthar thug gi bo li'i bde ba dang bdag med ma dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dang a yig dang padma dang de bzhin nyid dang stong nyid dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang rigs ldan ma la sogs pa'i rang bzhin phyag rgya chen mo rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid gsungs la/de yang rang stong ma yin pa'i stong nyid zab mo yin pa'i phyir shes byed khyad par du 'phags pa 'di rnams kyis kyang / mthar thug gzhi 'bras ngo bo dbyer med kyi phyag rgya chen mo dang yum chen mo dang bdag med ma dang a yig dang padma dang lhan cig skyes pa'i sku'am dga' ba dang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang ye shes lnga dang de bzhin nyid dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang rigs ldan ma la sogs pa rnams ni chos thams cad kyis stong pa'i gzhi chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa mi 'bral ba'i yon tan mtha' yas pa'i bdag nyid bde gshegs snying po dang sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid bdag dag pa'i bdag dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la dgongs nas gsungs pa ste/de ltar mthong na dgongs pa chen po'i don yang dag pa mthong ba yin no/ /de 192

lta ma yin na phyag rgya chen mo la sogs pa rnams kyi stong tshul rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs pa bzhin du rnyed par mi 'gyur ro/ / gzhan yang dpal rdo rje 'chang chen pos rgyud sde rin po che rnams su gsang ba zhes pa dang gsang chen zhes pa la sogs pas stong nyid mthar thug gi rnam grangs gsungs pa rnams kyang dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gang yin pa stong gzhi don dam gzhan stong la dgongs pa yin gyi/ dngos po med pa stong nyid tsam gang yin pa rang stong la ni dgongs pa ma yin te de dang de rnam grangs su mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /gal te gsang ba zhes pa rang stong gi rnam grangs yin na nyer len gyi phung po lnga yang rang stong yin pa'i phyir mthar thug nges don gyi gsang ba yin par 'gyur la/ 'dod na de rnams sher phyin yin pa ha cang thal bar 'gyur te/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i zhal snga nas/ gsang ba zhes pa drang ba'i don gyis las kyi phyag rgya'i bha ga brjod do/ /nges pa'i don gyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong pa nyid do zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir gzhi 'bras ngo bo dbyer med kyi sher phyin stong nyid du gsungs pa 'di yang rang stong ni ma yin gyi stong gzhi don dam gzhan stong dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yin te sher phyin yang yin la chos nyid kyang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du mthar thug gzhi 'bras ngo bo dbyer med kyi stong nyid zab mo'i rnam grangs su/gsang gnas chen mo mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba kun gyi bdag nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs zhes mkha' 'gro ma dang kun gyi bdag nyid la sogs pa dpal ldan phyag na rdo rjes rab tu gsungs shing / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa nyung ngu'i rgyud du yang / gsang chen mchog tu dgyes pa dang / /kun gyi bdag nyid na rtag bzhugs/ / zhes pa la sogs pas dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / gzhan gyi dngos po stong pa nyid gang yin pa stong gzhi don dam gzhan stong gi rnam grangs mang du gsungs so/ /193

gzhan yang dpal rdo rje 'chang gis mthar thug gzhi 'bras ngo bo dbyer med kyi chos 'byung dang gru gsum dang e yig dang rdo rje rol pa dang btsun mo'i bha ga dang sher phyin dang bde gshegs snying po la sogs pa stong pa nyid kyi rnam grangs mang po gsungs pa rnams kyang stong gzhi don dam gzhan stong la dgongs pa yin gyi rang stong ni de rnams kyi rnam grangs ma yin no/ / gal te yin na mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa sdig pa chen po mi bzad pa rnams kyang rang rang ngo bos sto/nga pa'i phyir de rnams yin par 'gyur la/ /'dod na de rnams sangs rgyas kun gyis bsten bya dang dkyil 'khor nyams dga' la sogs pa yang yin par ha cang thal bar 'gyur te/ dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud du/ sangs rgyas kun gyis bsten pa yi/ /gru gsum rnam dag 'di nyid ni/ /dbus su waṃ gis brgyan pa ste/ /e yig cha byad ji bzhin du/ /gru gsum dkyil 'khor nyams dga' bar/ / rdo rje rol pa zhes brjod de/ /btsun mo'i bha ga zhes bya zhing / /chos 'byung zhes kyang bshad pa yin/ /zhes dang / rgyud rnams kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ / gru gsum shin tu yangs pa'i gzugs/ / sems can kun gyi thun mong ba/ / lha min lhar bcas tshangs sogs kyi/ /gnas su de ni gyur pa ste/ /zhes dang / /de nyid shes rab pha rol phyin/ /de nyid yul las 'das pa ste/ /srog chags kun gyi snying la gnas/ /zhes sogs dang mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur du yang / bde ba can dang gru gsum dang / /rdul med dang ni skyon bral dang / /rdul bral dang ni sdig bcom dang / /rang bzhin dba' rlabs med pa dang / /mtha' yi bde dang bde rig dang / / gsang ba mchog dang dgyes pa dang / / zhes pa la sogs pas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan du ma'i bdag nyid du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhal snga nas kyang stong nyid zab mo'i rnam 194

grangs su gyur pa'i chos 'byung gi don gsungs pa chos 'byung gi sgras kyang de brjod de chos 'byung gang las rang bzhin med pa'i chos thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur pa'o/ / rang bzhin med pa'i chos rnams ni stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong rnams so/ / de rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ba ni chos 'byung ste sangs rgyas kyi zhing ngo / / zhes dang / de'i phyir chos 'byung ni chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin can sna tshogs yum bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor los 'khyud pa dus thams cad du sgrib pa thams cad dang bral ba'o zhes pa la 'dir yang bden gnyis rnam dbye shes dgos te/ don dam pa'i stobs bcu la sogs pa chos kyi phung po rnams ni chos 'byung nyid dang dbyer med pa'i phyir 'byung ba med pa'i 'byung ba zhes 'gal 'dus skyon med kyi man ngag las rig par bya'o/ /de bzhin du gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i zhal snga nas kyang / gsang chen mchog la bzhugs pa zhes pa la chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams gzhan ni gsang chen te/ de la bzhugs pa ni gsang chen mchog la bzhugs pa'o/ / zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs shing dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i 'grel par yang / e dang bha ga pad ma dang / /dag dang bde gnas bde ba can/ / seng ge'i khri dang dmigs pa med/ /de bzhin nyid dang pha rol phyin/ / ces dang / de bzhin du mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ mkha' dbyings bem min dwangs ba dang / /go 'byed rab tu gsal ba dang / /sna tshogs rdo rje gnas dang gzhi/ /kun gyi gnas dang yid 'ong ba/ /zhes pa la sogs pa nas/gsang chen mchog tu dgyes pa dang / /kun gyi bdag nyid na rtag bzhugs/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi ming sna tshogs kyi khyad par gyis gnas bstan pa gsungs so/ / zhes pa la sogs pas stong gzhi don dam gyi rnam grangs rdul med dang rdul bral dang skyon med dang sdig bcom dang rba rlabs med pa dang mthar thug 195

pa'i bde ba dang de rang rig pa dang gsang ba mchog dang bde ba can dang bde ba'i gnas dang rang bzhin rnam dag dang dgyes pa dang dmigs med dang ma kha' dbyings dang bem po min pa'i stong nyid dang srid gsum kun nas dwangs ba dang go 'byed dang rab gsal dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang chos rnams kyi gnas dang gzhi dang kun gyi dbyings dang gozungs ma yid 'ong dang rang bzhin/ zhes pa la sogs pa rnam pa mang pos gsungs so/ / de la rang bzhin ni rgyu rkyen las ma byung zhing ma bcos la gzhan gang la yang mi ltos par gsungs te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs kyi zhal snga nas/ rang bzhin rgyu dang rkyen las ni/ /'byung bar rigs pa ma yin no/ /rgyu dang rkyen las byung ba yi/ /rang bzhin byas pa can du 'gyur/ /rang bzhin byas pa can zhes byar/ /ji lta bur na rung bar 'gyur/ /rang bzhin dag ni bcos min dang / /gzhan la ltos pa med pa yin/ /zhes so/ de bzhin du/ slob dpon chen po ārya de ba'i zhal snga nas kyang / spyod bsdus sgron mar/ don dam pa'i bden pa de yang ma bcos pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dri ma med pa'i ngo bo nyid de/don 'di nyid gsal bar bya ba'i phyir tshul gcig par bstan pa'i mdo las/chos 'di sgra skad dag gis lung bstan te/ /chos dang sgra dag 'dir ni snang mi 'gyur/ /chos nyid tshul gcig dngos la'ang 'jug byed pa/ /bzod mchog bla na med la reg par 'gyur/ zhes dang / mchog tu dga' ba'i lus kyi ngo bo nyid kyi gzugs 'byung bar gyur pa'i gzugs kyi bdag nyid can gyi ming ni rdo rje 'chang chen po zhes bya'o/ /'khor ba'i 'ching ba las nges par grol bas na thar pa zhes bya'o/ / zhes sogs dang / gang mi phyed pa de ni mi skye ba'o/ /gang mi skye ba de ni mi 'jig par 'dod do/ /gang mi 'jig pa de dang ba'o/ /gang dang ba de dag pa'o/ /gang dag pa de dri ma med pa'o/ /gang dri ma med pa de 'od gsal ba'o/ /gang 'od gsal ba de sems kyi rang bzhin no/ / zhes 196

sogs dang /yang don dam pa'i bden pa bsdus pa'i the tshom gcod pa'i le'u las/da ni ming la mngon par zhen pa rnams kyi 'khrul ba bsal bar bya ba'i phyir/don dam pa'i ming gi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig la 'jug par bya ste/ de la dang por ni 'od gsal ba dang / thams cad stong pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang /rdo rje'i ye shes dang / bla na med pa'i ye shes dang / dri ma med pa dang / dngos po med pa dang / snang ba med pa dang / bdag med pa dang / bdag las 'das pa dang / sems can med pa dang / srog med pa dang / gang zag med pa dang /gso ba med pa dang / skye ba med pa dang / 'gag pa med pa dang / yi ge med pa dang / tshig med pa dang / dmigs su med pa dang / bla na med pa dang / brjod du med pa dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / mtha' yas pa dang / grangs med pa dang / dbang po las 'das pa dang / gnas med pa dang / mtshan nyid med pa dang / 'dus ma byas pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / mi g.yo ba dang /dmigs pa dang bral ba dang / rnam par mi shes pa dang / brtag tu med pa dang /zad pa med pa dang / tshig med pa dang / sgrib pa med pa dang / tshul gcig pa dang / zhi ba nyid dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dang / rang bzhin gyis dag pa dang / thog ma med pa dang / dbus med pa dang / tha ma med pa dang / 'gro ba med pa dang / 'ong ba med pa dang / ring po ma yin pa dang / nye ba ma yin pa dang /gcig pa ma yin pa dang / tha dad pa ma yin pa dang / reg par dka' ba dang /rnam par bsgom par dka' ba dang / bsam gtan nyid dang / yang dag pa dang /chos kyi sku dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / chad pa med pa'i mtha' dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / lus med pa dang / rdul med pa dang / mtha' med pa dang /grub pa dang / gsang ba grub pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par dag pa dang /lta ba rnam par dag pa dang / rgyu rnam par dag pa dang / 'bras bu rnam par dag pa dang / khams gsum rnam par dag pa dang / bsod nams rnam par dag pa dang /197

sdig pa rnam par dag pa dang / nyon mongs pa rnam par dag pa dang / las rnam par dag pa dang / skye ba rnam par dag pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dang / lam gyi rnam pa mkhyen pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / mnyam pa nyid dang / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs mi zad pa nyid dang / ye shes 'bab pa nyid dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad skyed pa dang / nyan thos thams cad kyi yum dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad skrun pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad 'byin pa dang / lha'i mig rnam par dag par byed pa dang / lha'i rna bar rab tu ster bar byed pa dang / gzhan gyi sems shes par byed pa dang / sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran par byed pa dang / rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med par byed pa dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad zad par byed pa'o/ /zhes dang / zung du 'jug pa'i sku yongs su rdzogs pa 'di'i ming gi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig la 'jug par bya ste/ rig pa chen po'i skyes bu'i gzugs dang / bden pa gnyis kyi tshul la gnas pa dang / rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i bdag nyid can dang thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid can dang / 'jig rten gsum gyi bdag nyid can dang / theg pa gsum gyi bdag nyid can dang / dkyil 'khor gsum gyi bdag nyid can dang / thabs kyi bdag nyid can dang / de bzhin du skyes bu dam pa dang / skyes bu mchog dang / skyes bu chen po dang / skyes bu cang shes pa dang / skyes bu dpa' bo dang / skyes bu brtan po dang / skyes bu 'dul ba dang / skyes bu 'dul ba po dang / skyes bu mchog dang / skyes bu kha lo bsgyu ra pa dang / skyes bu seng ge dang / skyes bu nam mkha' dang / skyes bu thams cad kyi bdag nyid can dang / skyes bu dag pa'i bdag nyid can zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin du 'khor ba las rgal ba dang / skam sar phyin pa dang / bde ba thob pa dang / 'jigs pa med pa thob pa dang / pha rol tu 'gro bas 'bar ba dang / tsher ma dkrugs pa dang / spros pa med pa dang / dge slong dang /dgra bcom pa dang / zag pa zad pa dang / ci yang med pa dang / dge sbyong dang /bram ze dang / rgyal rigs dang sangs rgyas kyi sras dang / nyon mongs pa med pa dang /198

dbang du gyur pa dang / sems rnam par grol ba dang / shes rab rnam par grol ba dang / kun shes pa dang / glang po chen po dang / bya ba byas pa dang / byed pa byas pa dang / khur bor ba dang / bdag gi don rjes su thob pa dang / srid par sbyor ba yongs su zad pa dang / yang dag pa'i bkas sems rnam par grol ba dang /sems thams cad la dbang thob pa dang / mchog tu pha rol tu phyin pa dang / 'khor ba'i pha rol gyi mtha' la gnas pa dang / ye shes kyi sku dang / rang byung ye shes zhes bshad do/ /zhes gsungs te/ gang du bshad ce na/ don dam pa'i mtshan brjod la sogs pa mthar thug nges pa'i don gyi gsung rab bla na med pa rnams su'o/ /de yang / dpal ldan te shrī yig dang / rdo rje 'chang dang gdul dka' 'dul ba'i mchog dang / dpa' bo'i mchog dang / 'jig rten gsum rgyal dang / rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang / gsang ba'i rgyal po dang / rnam rgyas pad ma dkar po'i spyan dang /pad ma rgyas pa'i zhal dang / lag na rdo rje dang / khyab bdag dang / 'gro ba'i bla ma dang / 'gro ba'i ston pa po dang / dam tshig chen po dang / de kho na nyid mkhyen pa dang / dbang po bsam pa mkhyen mchog dang / ye shes sku dang / gtsug tor chen po dang / tshig gi bdag po dang / rang byung ye shes dang / 'jam dpal dang /ye shes sems dpa' dang / don zab rgya chen gyi mchog dang / don chen gyi mchog dang / mtshungs med kyi mchog dang / rab tu zhi ba'i mchog dang / rtag tu dge ba'i mchog dang / rgyud chen dang / sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang / sngags 'chang mchog dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rkang gnyis mchog dang / ye shes lus can gyi 'jam dpal dang / gsang sngags mtha' dag gi rigs chen dang / gsang sngags kyi mchog dang / rig pa 'chad pa'i mchog dang / rang bzhin gyi rigs gsum dang / 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i rigs dang / 'jig rten snang byed rigs chen dang /phyag rgya chen po'i rigs mchog dang / gtsug tor chen po'i rigs chen dang /sngags kyi rgyal po drug dang / gnyis su med par 'byung ba dang / mi skye ba'i chos dang / brjod du med pa'i a ā dang / i yī dang / u u dang / e i dang /o au dang / i aḥdang / snying la gnas pa'i ye shes sku dang / sangs rgyas kyi 199

nga'am bdag dang / dus gsum du 'jug pa'i sangs rgyas dang / oṃ yig dang /rdo rje rnon po dang / sdug bsngal gcod pa dang / shes rab ye shes sku ngang / ye shes kyi tshogs sam sku dang / gsung gi dbang phyug dang / a ra pa tsa na dang / a las byung ba'i sangs rgyas dang / a yig dang / don chen 'gyur med dam pa dang /srog chen po dang / skye ba med pa dang / brjod du med pa dang / brjod pa kun gyi rgyu'i mchog dang / 'od gsal gyi tshig kun dang / mchod pa chen po dang / 'dod chags chen po dang / zhe sdang chen po dang / gti mug chen po dang / khro ba chen po dang / chags pa chen po dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad gdod nas bcom pa dang /'dod pa chen po dang / bde ba chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / mgu ba chen po dang / gzugs chen po dang / lus chen po dang / kha dog chen po dang / lus bong chen po dang / ming chen po dang / rgya chen po dang / dkyil 'khor chen po yangs pa dang / shes rab chen po'i mchog dang / mtshon 'chang ba'i mchog dang /nyon mongs chen po dang / lcags kyu mchog dang / grags pa chen po dang / snyan grags chen po dang / snang ba chen po dang / gsal ba chen po dang / mkhas pa chen po'am/ rig pa chen po dang / sgyu 'phrul chen po 'dzin dang / sgyu 'phrul chen po'i don sgrub dang / sgyu 'phrul chen po'i dga' bas dga' ba dang / sgyu 'phrul chen po'i mig 'phrul can dang / sbyin bdag chen po dang / gtso bo'i cha5/chog dang / tshul khrims chen po 'chad pa'i mchog dang / bzod chen 'chang ba'i mchog dang / brtan pa chen po'i mchog dang / brtson 'grus chen po'i mchog dang / pha rol gnon pa'i mchog dang / bsam gtan chen po dang / ting 'dzin mchog la gnas pa dang /shes rab chen po'i sku 'chang dang / stobs po che dang / thabs mkhas chen po dang /smon lam rgya mtsho dang / ye shes rgya mtsho dang / byams pa chen po dang / rang bzhin dpag med dang / snying rje chen po'i mchog dang / blo yi mchog dang / shes rab chen po'i mchog dang / blo chen ldan pa'i mchog dang / thabs chen gyi mchog dang /byed pa chen po'i mchog dang / 'phrul chen gyi mchog dang / stobs ldan gyi mchog dang / shugs chen gyi mchog dang / mgyogs chen gyi mchog dang / rdzu 'phrul che 200

zhing che bar grags pa'i mchog dang / stobs chen pha rol gnon pa'i mchog dang /srid pa'i ri bo 'joms pa'i mchog dang / mkhregs pa'i mchog dang / rdo rje chen po 'chang ba'i mchog dang / drag po chen po'i mchog dang / drag shul che ba'i mchog dang / 'jigs chen yang 'jigs par mdzad pa po dang / mgon po'i mchog chen po dang / rig pa'i mchog chen po dang / bla ma chen po'i mchog dang / gsang sngags chen po'i mchog dang / theg chen tshul la gnas pa'am brtan pa'i mchog dang /theg chen tshul gyi mchog dang / sangs rgyas chen po dang / rnam par snang mdzad chen po dang / thub pa chen po'i mchog dang / thub chen ldan pa'i mchog dang / gsang sngags tshul chen las byung ba dang / gsang sngags tshul chen gyi bdag dang / pha rol phyin bcu thob pa'i mchog dang / phar phyin bcu la gnas pa'i mchog dang / pha rol phyin bcu dag pa'i mchog dang / pha rol phyin bcu'i tshul gyi mchog dang / sa bcu'i dbang phyug gi mgon po mchog dang / sa bcu la gnas pa'i mchog dang / shes bcu rnam dag gi bdag dang / shes bcu rnam dag 'chang ba po dang / rnam pa bcu po don bcu'i don dang / thub dbang khyab pa'i bdag dang / stobs bcu khyab pa'i bdag dang / kun don ma lus mdzad pa po dang / rnam bcu dbang ldan che ba po dang /thog ma med pa'i bdag dang / spros pa med pa'i bdag dang / de bzhin nyid kyi bdag dang / gdod nas dag pa'i bdag dang / bden par gsung ba'i mchog dang / gsung mi 'gyur ba'i mchog dang / ji skad smras bzhin mdzad pa'i mchog dang / gnyis su med pa'i mchog dang / gnyis med ston pa'i mchog dang / yang dag mthar bzhugs dang / bdag med pa'i sgra sgrogs mchog dang / mu stegs ngan pa 'jigs mdzad mchog dang / kun 'gro'i mchog dang / don yod pa'i gnas sam stobs kyi mchog dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang yid ltar mgyogs pa'i mchog dang /rgyal ba'i mchog dang / dgra las rgyal ba'i mchog dang / rnam par rgyal ba'i mchog dang / 'khor lo bsgyur pa'i mchog dang / stobs po che'i mchog dang / tshogs kyi slob dpon gyi mchog dang / tshogs kyi gtso bo'i mchog dang / tshogs rje'i mchog dang / tshogs bdag gi mchog dang / dbang ldan gyi mchog dang / mthu chen gyi 201

mchog dang / gces par 'dzin pa'i mchog dang / tshul chen gyi mchog dang /gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog gi mchog dang / tshig rje'i mchog dang / tshig bdag gi mchog dang / smra mkhas kyi mchog dang / tshig la dbang ba'i mchog dang / tshig mtha' yas pa'i mchog dang / tshig bden pa'i mchog dang / bden smra'i mchog dang / bden bzhi ston pa'i mchog dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i mchog dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i mchog dang / 'dren pa'i mchog dang / rang rgyal ba'i mchog dang / bse ru lta bu'i mchog dang / nges 'byung sna tshogs kyis nges 'byung gi mchog dang /'byung ba chen po'am yod pa chen po'am bden pa chen po'am yang dag chen po dang /kun gyi rgyu'am rten nam gnas gcig pu dang / dge slong gi mchog dang / dgra bcom pa'i mchog dang / zag pa zad pa'i mchog dang / chags bral gyi mchog dang /dbang po thul bu'i mchog dang / bde ba rnyed pa'i mchog dang / 'jigs med thob pa'i mchog dang / bsil bar gyur pa'i mchog dang / rnyog pa med pa'am gos pa med pa'i mchog dang / rig pa dang rkang par ldan pa'i mchog dang / bde gshegs sam bder gnas sam bde ba rtogs pa dang / 'jig rten rig pa'i mchog dang /nga bdag tu mi 'dzin pa dang / bden gnyis tshul du bzhugs pa dang / gdod nas 'khor ba'i mthar son dang / gdod nas bya ba byas pa dang / gdod nas skam sar gnas pa dang / ye shes 'ba' zhig pa dang / nges par bsal ba'am nges 'byung mchog dang / shes rab mtshon chas rnam 'joms kyi mchog dang / dam chos kyi mchog dang / chos kyi rgyal po'i mchog dang / gas la ba'am snang ba'i mchog dang /'jig rten snang byed kyi mchog dang / chos kyi dbang phyug dang / chos kyi rgyal po dang /legs pa'i lam mam lam mchog ston pa po dang / don grub pa'i mchog dang /bsam pa grub pa'i mchog dang / kun rtog thams cad spangs pa dang / rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings dang / mi zad pa'i mchog dang / chos dbyings dam pa dang /zad mi shes pa'i mchog dang / rang bzhin gyi bsod nams dang ldan pa dang /gdod nas bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / gdod nas rang byung gi ye shes dang ye shes kyi 'byung gnas chen po dang / ye shes ldan pa'i mchog dang / yod pa la yo da par 202

shes shing med pa la med par shes pa'i mchog dang / gdod nas rang bzhin gyis tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang rtag pa'i mchog dang / kun las rgyal ba'i mchog dang /gdod nas rnal 'byor can dang / gdod nas bsam gtan gyi mchog dang / bsam bya'i mchog dang / blo ldan gyi mchog dang / bdag gi mchog dang / so so rang rig gi mchog dang / mi g.yo ba'i mchog dang / mchog gi dang po dang sku gsum 'chang ba dang / sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag dang / kun la khyab pa'i bdag dang / ye shes lnga yi bdag dang / sangs rgyas lnga bdag gi cod pan dang / gdod nas spyam lnga chags med 'chang ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa po dang / sangs rgyas sras po dang / dam pa'am gzhan nam pha rol lam mchog dang / shes rab kyi mchog dang /gdod nas srid 'byung dang skye gnas med pa'am/ skye gnas kyi mchog dang / rang bzhin gyi chos las 'byung ba'am chos kyi skye gnas mchog dang / gdod nas srid pa bsal ba'am srid pa mthar mdzad dang / gcig pu'i bdag dang / sra mkhregs kyi bdag dang / rdo rje'i bdag dang / nam yang skyes ma thag pa ste nam yang mi rga ba dang 'gro ba'i bdag po dang / nam mkha' las byung rang byung ba'i mchog dang /rang byung dang / shes rab ye shes kyi me chen dang / shes rab ye shes kyi 'od chen dang / shes rab ye shes kyi rnam snang mdzad dang / ye shes snang ba lam me ba dang /'gro ba'i snang gsal gyi mchog dang / ye shes sgron ma dang / gdod nas gzi brjid chen po dang / rang bzhin 'od gsal ba dang / sngags mchog gi mnga' bdag dang /rig pa'i rgyal po dang / gsang sngags rgyal po dang / don chen mdzad pa po dang /gtsug tor chen po dang / gtsug tor rmad byung dang / nam mkha'i bdag po dang /sna tshogs ston pa'i mchog dang / sangs rgyas kun bdag dang / dngos po'i mchog dang / 'gro ba'i mchog dang / kun dga'i mchog dang / mig ldan gyi mchog dang /sna tshogs gzugs can skyed pa po'i mchog dang / mchod 'os rjed 'os kyi mchog dang /drang srong chen po'i mchog dang / rang bzhin gyi rigs gsum 'chang ba dang /gsang sngags ldan pa'i mchog dang / gdod nas dam tshig chen po dang / gsang sngags gdod nas 'dzin pa dang / gtso bo'i mchog dang / chos nyid kyi dkon 203

mchog gsum dang / de rnams 'chang ba dang / theg pa gsum mchog ston pa'i mchog dang / don yod zhags pa'i mchog dang / rang bzhin gyi rnam par rgyal ba dang / thig le 'dzin pa chen po dang / rdo rje zhags pa'i mchog dang / rdo rje lcags kyu'i mchog dang rdo rje zhags pa chen po'i mchog dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed dang /'jigs pa'ang 'jigs mdzad dang / khro bo'i rgyal po dang / gdong drug 'jigs pa dang / mig drug pa ste dbang po thams cad pa dang / lag pa drug pa ste yan lag thams cad pa dang / stobs thams cad pa dang / kai ka la'i mchog dang / mche ba gtsigs pa'i mchog dang / khro chen ha lā ha lā dang / gdong brgya pa'am zhal thams cad pa dang / gshin rje'i gshed po dang / bgegs kyi rgyal po'i mchog dang / rdo rje shugs dang / 'jigs byed kyi mchog dang / rdo rje dregs pa dang / rdo rje'i snying po dang / rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul dang / rdo rje gsus po che dang / rdo rje las skyes pa'am rdo rje'i skye gnas dang / rdo rje'i bdag dang / rdo rje'i snying po'am rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor mkha' 'dra dang / mi g.yo ba dang / bde chen ral ba gcig pa'am ral gcig ma dang / rdo rje bsgyings pa dang / glang chen ko rlon gyon pa ste 'chi bdag gdod nas bcom pa dang / drag po chen po dang / gad rgyangs kyis 'jigs par byed pa'i mchog dang / chos nyid kyi gad mo chen po dang / de bzhin nyid kyi gad rgyangs can dang / rdo rje'i gad mo cher sgrogs dang / rdo rje sems dpa' dang /sems dpa' chen po dang / rdo rje rgyal po dang / bde chen mchog dang / rdo rje drag po'am rdo rje gtum mo dang / rdo rje dga' ba chen po dang / rdo rje hūṃ dang / rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang / rdo rje'i mda' 'am de thogs pa dang / rdo rje'i ral gri dang / 'ching ba kun gcod dang / rdo rje kun 'chang dang / rdo rje can dang / rdo rje gcig pu dang / g.yul las rgyal ba'am g.yul sel dang / rdo rje 'bar ba'i mig mi bzad pa dang / rdo rje 'bar ba'i skra dang / rdo rje 'bebs pa dang / 'bebs pa chen po dang /spyan brgya rgyas pa dang / rdo rje'i spyan dang / rdo rje'i ba spu'am de'i lus dang / rdo rje'i spu dang / rdo rje'i gcig pu'i sku dang / rdo rje'i sen mo dang / rdo rje'i lpags pa dang / rdo rje'i phreng thogs dang / rdo rje'i dpal ldan dang / rdo rje'i rgyan nam des 204

brgyan pa dang / brjod du med pa'i gad rgyangs dang / yi ge drug pa'am 'gyur med drug pa dang / rdo rje'i sgra dang / 'jam dbyangs chen po dang / yi ge med pa'i sgra chen po'am nā da chen po dang / 'jig rten gsum gcig pa'i sgra'am 'jig rten gsum gzhan gyi sgra du ma ro gcig pa dang / sgra med kyi sgra mkha' khyab dang / sgra ldan rnams kyi mchog dang / yang dag pa'i don dang / bdag med pa'i dbyings dang /de bzhin nyid dang / yang dag mtha' dang / yi ge med pa'i gzhi dang / stong nyid smra ba'i khyu mchog dang / zab yangs chos nyid kyi sgra sgrogs pa dang / rang bzhin lhun grub kyi chos dung dang / de bzhin nyid kyi gaṇa ḍi dang / mi gnas pa'i myang 'das dang / rtag tu kun khyab yongs grub kyi rnga chen dang / gzugs med pa'i gzugs bzang dang / gzugs med pa'i gzugs dam pa dang / kun tu bzang po las byung ba'i sna tshogs gzugs dang / dpal thams cad kyi gzugs rnams snang ba dang /gzugs brnyan ma lus 'chang ba'i chos sku dang / gang gis kyang tshugs pa med pa'am 'dzin pa med pa dang / che bar grags pa'am grags pa chen po dang / khams gsum gzhan dang / de'i dbang phyug chen po dang / 'phags lam shin tu mthon po dang /de la gnas pa'i mchog dang / ma rgud cing dar ba chen po'i mchog dang / chos kyi tog dam pa dang / 'jig rten gsum gcig gzhon nu'i lus te chos nyid kyi 'jig rten gsum dang / gnas brtan gyi mchog dang / rgan po'i mchog dang / skye rgu'i bdag gi mchog dang / chos 'byung gi mtshan dpe 'chang ba dang / sdug gu'am yid du 'ong bas 'dod par bya ba'i mchog dang / gsang chen gyi 'jig rten gsum mdzes pa dang / 'jig rten shes pa'i mchog dang / kun nas legs pa'i mchog dang /kun gyi slob dpon gyi mchog dang / 'jig rten slob dpon 'jigs med kyi mchog dang / 'jig rten mgon po'i mchog dang / 'jig rten skyob pa'i mchog dang / 'jig rten gyi yid gcugs pa'i gnas sam 'jig rten gsum khyab dang / skyabs bla na med pa dang / skyob pa bla na med pa dang / gzhan nam mkha'i mtha' la longs spyod pa'am nam mkha' khyab par longs spyod pa dang / kun mkhyen ye shes rgya mtsho dang /ma rig sgong nga'i spubs 'byed dang / srid pa'i dra ba gdod nas bcom zhing 'joms 205

pa dang / nyon mongs gdod nas zhi zhing zhi byed dang / 'khor ba'i pha rol tu gdod nas rang bzhin gyis phyin pa dang / ye shes dbang bskur gdod nas thob pa dang /gdod nas ye shes lnga'i cod pan can dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyan du rang bzhin gyis thogs pa'am brgyan pa dang / sdug bsngal thams cad rang bzhin gyis zhi ba dang /gsum sel ba'i mchog dang / mtha' yas pa'i mchog dang / grol ba gsum thob pa'i mchog dang / sgrib pa kun las ngo bo nyid kyis nges par grol ba dang / mkha' ltar mnyam pa nyid la rtag tu gnas pa dang / nyon mongs dri ma kun las rtag tu 'das pa dang / dus med pa'i dus gsum mngon par rtogs pa dang / sems can kun gyi klu chen mchog dang / yon tan gyi thod can rnams kyi thod dang / nyon mongs kun las gdod nas grol ba'am/ lhag ma kun las gzod ma nas grol ba dang / gzhan nam mkha'i lam la rab gnas dang / gzhan yid bzhin nor bu'am de 'chang ba dang /kun khyab kyi rin chen mchog dang / gzhan dpag bsam gyi shing chen rgyas pa dang /gzhan bum bzang chen po'i mchog dang / byed pa po'i mchog dang / sems can kun don mdzad pa po dang / sems can la phan 'dogs shing mnyes gshin pa'i mchog dang / bzang ngan shes pa'i mchog dang / dus shes pa'i mchog dang / khyab bdag gi dam tshig shes pa'i mchog dang / khyab bdag gi dam tshig ldan pa'i mchog dang / khyab bdag gi dus shes shing sems can gyi dbang po shes pa'i mchog dang /rnam grol gsum la mkhas pa po dang / bha ga bzang mo'i yon tan thams cad ldan zhing shes pa dang / chos kun shes pa'i mchog dang / rab tu zhi ba'i bkra shis 'byung ba'i mchog dang / bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa'i mchog dang / bkra shis kyi grags pa 'am grags pa phun tshogs dang / snyan pa rgyas pa'i mchog dang / yod pa'i dge ba'am don dam pa'i dge ba'am byas pa'i dge ba dang / dbugs byin pa chen po'i mchog dang / dga' ston chen po'i mchog dang / dga' ston gyi rol pa chen po'i mchog dang / bkur sti rim gro phun tshogs bya ba'i gnas dang / mchog tu dga' ba'am rab tu dga' ba'i dpal dang / grags pa chen po'i bdag gi dpal dang /mchog ldan gyi gtso bo dang / mchog sbyin gyi gtso bo dang / skyabs kyi dam pa dang /206

skyabs su 'os pa'i mchog dang / 'jigs chen kun gyi dgra dang / 'jigs chen dgra yi rab mchog dang / 'jigs pa ma lus gdod nas bsal zhing sel ba po dang /gtsug phud gyi mchog dang / phud bu'i mchog dang / lcang lo can gyi mchog dang /ral ba'i mchog dang / mun dza'am mgo reg gi mchog dang / cod pan thogs pa'i mchog dang / rigs lnga pa rnams kyi mchog dang / mgo zlum gyi mchog dang /brtul zhugs chen po 'chang ba'i mchog dang / tshangs spyod kyi brtul zhugs mchog dang / dka' thub mthar phyin pa'i mchog dang / dka' thub che ba'i mchog dang /gtsang mar gnas pa'i mchog dang / gau ta ma'i mchog dang / bram ze'i mchog dang /tshangs pa'i mchog dang / tshangs pa'i rig pa'am shes pa'i mchog dang / tshangs par mya ngan las 'das pa thob pa'i mchog dang / grol ba'i lus kyi mchog dang / thar pa'i lus kyi mchog dang / rnam grol lus kyi mchog dang / rnam grol zhi ba'i mchog dang / gdod nas spros pa zhi ba nyid dang / rang bzhin gyis mya ngan las 'das pa dang / nye bar zhi bar mya ngan las 'das pa dang / legs par nges 'byung mthar mdzad dang / zag bcas kyi bde sdug sel ba'am mthar byed gnas dang / chags bral gyi mchog dang / lus las 'das pa'am btags pa zad pa'am nyer len zad pa'i mchog dang / thub pa med pa'i mchog dang / dpe med pa'i mchog dang /rnam shes la mi mngon mi snang gsal byed min pa'i mchog dang / cha med kun 'gro kun khyab kyi mchog dang / phra zhing rtogs par dka' ba'i mchog dang / chos thams cad kyi sa bon nam gzhi'i mchog dang / zag pa med pa'i dbyings dang / rdul med rdul bral dri med kyi mchog dang / nyes pa thams cad gdod nas spangs pa'i mchog dang /rang bzhin gyis skyon med pa'i mchog dang / ye shes shin tu sad pa'i mchog dang /chos nyid rnam par sad pa'i bdag dang / kun mkhyen kun rig gi mchog dang /rnam shes las 'das pa'i mchog dang / gnyis med ye shes kyi tshul dang / mi rtog lhun grub dang dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad pa'i mchog dang / thog mtha' med pa'i sangs rgyas dang / dang po'i sangs rgyas dang / rgyud dam ris med par 'dres pa'i sangs rgyas dang / dri med ye shes kyi spyan gcig pu dang / ye shes 207

lus can gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dang / tshig gi dbang phyug dang / smra ba chen po dang / smra ba'i skyes mchog dang / smra ba'i rgyal po dang / smra ba'i dam pa dang /mchog gi gnas sam gzhi dang / smra ba'i seng ge tshugs med dam thub pa med pa'i mchog dang / kun tu lta ba'am kun nas gzigs pa'i mchog dang / gdod nas mchog tu dga' ba dang / gdod nas gzi brjid phreng ba dang / lta na sdug pa'i mchog dang / rang bzhin 'od bzang 'bar ba dang / gdod nas dpal gyi be'u dang / gsal zhing 'od byed snang ba'i mchog dang / sman pa chen po'i mchog dang /sman pa chen po'i gtso bo dang / zug rngu 'byin pa bla na med pa dang / sman rnams ma lus tshang ba'i ljon pa mchog dang / nad rnams kun gyi dgra chen mchog dang / sdug gu 'jig rten gsum gyi mchog ste srid gsum gzhan dang / dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor dang / chos kyi rgyal mtshan mkha' khyab dang / chos kyi gdugs mchog yangs pa gcig gis kun khyab dang / byams dang thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor mchog dang /dpal ldan pad ma gar gyi bdag gam dbang phyug dang / khyab bdag chos sku'i rin chen gdugs dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi gzi brjid dam rgyal po chen po dang /sangs rgyas kun bdag gi ngo bo 'chang ba dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi rnal 'byor chen po dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan pa gcig pu dang / rdo rje rin po che'i mchog dang /dpal gyi dbang bskur ba'i mchog dang / rin chen kun gyi bdag gi mchog dang /rin chen kun gyi dbang phyug gi mchog dang / 'jig rten dbang phyug kun gyi bdag dang / rdo rje 'chang ba kun gyi rje dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs chen po dang /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs la gnas pa dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi sku chen po dang /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsungs chen po dang / rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che dang / rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od dang / chags bral dang po chags pa che dang / kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od dang / rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i gnas dang / sangs rgyas gsung gi chos 'dzin pa dang / dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad ma las skyes pa dang / kun mkhyen ye shes mdzod 'dzin pa dang / sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs 'chang ba'i rgyal po dang / sangs rgyas rig pa 'chang ba chen po dang / rdo rje rmon po'i mchog dang / ral gri chen po'i 208

mchog dang / rnam dag 'gyur med mchog dang / theg chen gyi mchog dang / sdug bsngal gcod pa'i mchog dang / mtshon cha chen po'i mchog dang / rdo rje chos dang /rdo rje zab mo dang / dzi na dzi ga gam rgyal ba'i rgyal ba dang / rdo rje'i blo gros dang /don bzhin du rig pa'i mchog dang / pha rol phyin kun gdod nas rdzogs pa dang /chos nyid kyis rnam kun dang / de rnams kyi rgyan dang ldan pa dang / rnam par dag pa'i chos dang / bdag med ba'i chos dang / yang dag ye shes dang / chos dbyings kyi zla 'od bzang po dang / chos nyid kyi brtson chen nam rnal 'byor chen po dang / chos nyid kyi sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang / chos nyid kyi rgyud rnams kun gyi bdag po mchog dang / rdo rje'i gdan nam gnas kun ldan pa'am rdo rje kun gyi mthar thug pa dang / ye shes sku rnams ma lus 'chang ba dang / kun tu bzang po dang / chos nyid kyi blo gros bzang po dang / kun nas spyan sa'i snying po dang / 'gro ba 'dzin pa'i mchog dang / sangs rgyas snying po ste bde gshegs snying po dang / sprul ba'i 'khor lo sna tshogs 'chang ba mchog dang / chos nyid kyi dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin mchog dang chos nyid kyi dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin 'dzin dang / skye med kyi chos nyid sna tshogs don du snang ba dang / chos rnams kun gyi ngo bo nyid 'chang ba dang / skad cig tsam la chos kun khong du chud pa'i shes rab chen po dang / chos kun mngon par rtogs pa'i mchog dang / chos nyid thub pa blo mchog dang / 'byung po'i mtha' 'am yang dag mtha' 'am yod pa'i mtha' 'am bden pa'i mtha' dang / mi g.yo ba'i bdag dam pa dang / rab tu dang ba'i bdag dam pa dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub 'chang dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi mngon sum pa dang / ye shes me lce 'od rab gsal dang / 'dod pa'i don grub dam pa dang / ngan song thams cad rnam sbyong ba'am nyes pa thams cad sbyong mdzad pa dang / sems can kun gyi mgon po mchog dang /sems can thams cad rab grol mdzad dang / nyon mongs g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo gcig pu dang / ma rig pa'am mi shes pa'i dgra'i dregs pa 'joms pa dang /chos nyid kyi blo ldan dang / sgeg 'chang gi mchog dang / dpal ldan gyi mchog dang /chos nyid brtan pa'i mchog gam dpa' bo dang / mi sdug gzugs 'chang khros pa'i 209

mchog dang / kun nas phyag dang / kun nas zhabs dang / phyag thams cad pa dang / gar mkhan gyi mchog dang / rdul dang nyi ma rang bzhin gyis dag pa dang /khu ba dang zla ba gdod nas dag pa dang / don gcig gnyis med chos kyi don dang /don dam pa 'jig pa med pa dang / chos nyid kyi rnam rig sna tshogs gzugs don can dang / chos nyid kyi sems kyi rgyud dam yod pa'i sems dang / chos nyid kyi rnam shes kyi rgyud dam yod pa'i rnam shes dang / chos nyid kyi dngos don ma lus pa dang / chos nyid kyi dga' ba ma lus pa dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi dga' ba dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi 'dod chags dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi blo gros dang / srid pa'i nyon mongs gdod nas spangs pa'i gzhi dang / srid gsum gzhan gyi dga' ba chen po dang / gdod nas dag pa'i khu ba'i sprin dkar dang / chos nyid kyi ston zla'i 'od bzang dang / chos nyid kyi nyi ma gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor mdzes pa dang / 'dod chags chen po sen mo'i 'od dang / chos nyid kyi zur phud bzang po mthon ka mchog dang / chos nyid kyi skra mchog mthon ka chen po 'chang dang / chos nyid kyi nor bu chen po 'od chags dpal dang / sangs rgyas sprul ba'i rgyan ldan mchog dang / 'jig rten khams brgya kun bskyod mchog dang / rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i stobs chen ldan pa'i mchog dang / de nyid dran pa chen po 'chang ba'i mchog dang / dran pa bzhi po'i rgyal po mchog dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi rgyal po dang / chos dbyings byang chub yan lag gi me tog spos sam me tog dga' ba dang / chos nyid kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan mtsho dang /gnyug ma'i lam gyi yan lag brgyad tshul rig pa'i mchog dang / sangs rgyas kyi lam yang dag par rig pa'i mchog dang / sems can kun la shas cher chags pa'i mchog dang / nam mkha' lta bur chags med kyi mchog dang / sems can kun gyi yid la gdod nas zhugs pa dang / sems can kun gyi yid gzhan gdod nas mgyogs pa dang / sems can kun gyi dbang don shes pa'i mchog dang / sems can kun gyi yid 'phrog pa'i mchog dang / phung po lnga don de nyid shes pa'i mchog dang / rnam dag phung po lnga 'chang ba'i mchog dang / nges 'byung kun gyi mtha' la gnas pa'i 210

mchog dang / nges par 'byung ba kun la mkhas kyi mchog dang / nges 'byung kun gyi lam la gnas pa'i mchog dang / nges par 'byung ba kun ston pa'i mchog dang /yan lag bcu gnyis srid rtsa bton kyi mchog dang / dag pa rnam pa bcu gnyis 'chang gi mchog dang / chos nyid bden bzhi'i rnam pa can dang / chos nyid kyi shes pa brgyad po rtogs pa 'chang dang / bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis ldan dang / de nyid rnam pa bcu drug rig dang / rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa dang / rnam par sangs rgyas kun rig mchog dang / sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul sku dpag med 'gyed pa po dang /skad cig thams cad mngon par rtogs pa'i mchog dang / sems kyi skad cig gcig la don kun rig pa'i mchog dang / theg pa sna tshogs kyis 'gro don mdzad pa'i mchog dang / theg pa gsum gyis nges 'byung ston yang theg pa gcig tu gdod nas gnas pa dang / las dang nyon mongs gdod nas zad pa'i bdag dang / chu bo rgya mtsho sbyor ba kun las gdod nas rgal ba dang / nyon mongs kyi bag chags kyang gdod nas spangs pa dang / snying rje chen po'i mchog dang / shes rab thabs kyi mchog dang / don yod pa'i mchog dang / 'gro don mdzad pa'i mchog dang / 'du shes rnam shes gdod nas 'gags pa'i gzhi'i don dang / gzhan sems can kun gyi yid kyi yul dang / sems can kun gyi yid rig pa'i mchog dang / sems can kun gyi yid la gdod nas bzhugs dang / de dag sems dang mnyam par 'jug pa dang / sems can kun yid tshim par byed pa dang / sems can kun gyi yid la gnas pa'i dga' ba chen po dang / gdod nas grub pa mthar phyin 'khrul ba med pa dang / nor ba thams cad gdod nas spangs pa'i gzhi dang / don gsum the tshom med pa'i blo dang / kun don yon tan gsum gyi bdag dang / phung po dang dus gsum du gtogs pa'i skad cig thams cad bye brag phyed pa dang / skad cig gcig mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas dang /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin 'chang dang / lus med pa'i lus kyi mchog dang /lus kyi mtha' gdod nas rtogs pa'am sku bye ba 'gyed pa dang / chos nyid kyi gzugs rnams ma lus kun tu ston dang / gsang ba'i nor bu chen po rin chen tog dang /sangs rgyas kun gyi rtogs bya'i gsang chen dang / gdod nas sangs rgyas byang chub bla 211

na med pa dang / gsang sngags skye gnas yi ge med pa'i gzhi dang / gsang sngags chen po rigs gsum pa dang / gsang sngags don kun skyed pa po dang / thig le chen po yi ge med dang / stong pa chen po yi ge lnga 'am 'gyur med lnga dang / thig le stong pa yi ge drug gam 'gyur med drug dang / rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med dang / thig le bzhi gajod nas 'dzin pa dang / cha med cha las 'das pa dang / chos nyid kyi bsam gtan bzhi'i rtse mo'am mtha' gdod nas 'dzin pa dang / bsam gtan mchog gi yan lag gam cha kun shes pa dang / ting 'dzin rig dang rgyud rig pa'i mchog dang /rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi lus can dang / lus kyi mchog de bzhin nyid kyi lus dang / longs spyod rdzogs sku kun gyi rgyal po ste de bzhin nyid kyi longs spyod rdzogs sku dang / sprul sku'i mchog chos nyid kyi sprul sku dang / sangs rgyas sprul ba'i rgyud 'chang ba dang/ phyogs bcur sprul ba sna tshogs 'gyed dang / ji bzhin 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa dang / lha'i lha ste rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi lha dang / lha dbang gi mchog chos nyid kyi lha dbang dang / chos nyid kyi lha min dbang po dang / chos nyid kyi sbyin byed bdag po dang / chos nyid kyi 'chi med dbang po dang / lha'i bla ma'i mchog rang byung ye shes dang / 'joms byed kyi mchog glo bur dri ma 'joms byed kyi rtsa ba dang / 'joms byed kyi dbang phyug gnyis med kyi ye shes sam yang na lha'i lha la sogs pa de rnams tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug dang stobs ldan dang sgra gcan dang brgya byin dang phur bu dang tshogs bdag dang srid pa'i dgon pa las rang bzhin gyis brgal ba dang 'gro ba'i ston pa gcig pu dang 'gro ba'i bla ma gcig pu dang 'jig rten phyogs bcur grags pa'i mchog dang / chos kyi sbyin bdag che ba'i mchog dang / byams pa'i go cha gyon pa'i mchog dang / snying rje'i ya lad bgos pa'i mchog dang / shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu thogs dang / sgrib gnyis g.yul ngo gdod nas bsal ba dang / bdud kyi dgra dang bdud rnams gdod nas thul ba'i dpa' bo dang / bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa sel mdzad dang / bdud dpung pham mdzad dang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig 'dren pa dang / mchog 'os bstod 'os phyag gi gnas kyi mchog dang / rtag tu ri mor bya ba'i 'os kyi mchog dang / bkur 'os brjed par bya ba'i 'os kyi mchog dang /212

phyag byar 'os pa bla ma'i rab dang / 'jig rten gsum la gom pa gcig gis bgrod cing khyab pa dang / mkha' ltar mtha' med rnam par gnon pa'i mchog dang /gsum rig gtsang ma dag pa'i mchog dang / mngon
