rnam dag chos nyid kyi khams drug po don dam gyi de bzhin gshegs ma drug tu bzhugs tshul/ rnam dag chos nyid kyi yan lag bcu gnyis don dam gyi sa dang bden don bcu gnyis la sogs par bzhugs tshul/ rnam dag chos nyid kyi phar phyin rnams don dam gyi nus ma dang rig ma dang mkha' 'gro ma dang phyag rgya mar bzhugs tshul/ rnam dag chos nyid kyi stong nyid thams cad don dam gyi lha dang snying rje dang bde ba chen por bzhugs tshul/ rnam dag chos nyid kyi byang chub phyogs gyi chos rnams don dam gyi lha dang rgyud dang gnas la sogs par bzhugs tshul/ rnam dag chos nyid kyi 'phags pa'i bden bzhi la sogs pa chos thams cad don dam gyi lha rnams su bzhugs tshu'// ma dag pa kun rdzob kyi gzugs sogs ni rnam dag chos nyid kyi lha rnams ma yin par bstan pa/ tshul de ltar mkhas grub chen po dag gis kyang mdo rgyud dang sbyar nas gsungs tshul/ rnam dag chos nyid kyi chags sogs dang dus gsum la sogs pa chos thams cad don dam gyi lhar bzhugs tshul/ rnam dag chos nyid kyi bdag dang sems can la sogs pa yang don dam gyi lha rnams su bzhugs tshul/ rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi gzugs sogs kyang sngar bstan pa rnams dang don gcig tshul/ 'pho 'gyur dang skye 'gag med pa'i gzugs sogs kyang sngar bstan pa rnams dang don gcig tshul/ don de dag yum rgyas 'bring la sogs pa'i dgongs pa yin par bstan pa/ de rnams gnas lugs kyi sngags dang rgyud dang dkyil 'khor dang phyag rgya la sogs par yang bzhugs tshul lo/ /brgyad pa la lnga/ stong nyid thams cad rang stong gzhan stong gnyis su legs par gtan la dbab pa/ de dag las stong gzhi gang yin thams cad don dam gyi lha dang snying rje la sogs par bzhugs tshul/ de ltar rtogs na mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i dbus ma'am bar ma ma ning dang dpe bral dang phung 437

po gsum par rtog tshul/ de la 'khrul ba'i log rtog mang po spangs nas don yin lugs bzhin bstan pa/ stong nyid ji snyed gsungs pa thams cad kyi stong tshul gnyis gnyis su bsdus nas bstan pa ste lam gyi skabs/ /'bras bu'i skabs/lam des bral ba dang bskyed pa'i 'bras bu bshad pa la gsum/ theg chen 'bras bu spyir bstan pa/ de'i don rgyas par bshad pa/ phyag 'tshal zhing nye bar bsdu ba'o/ /bar ba la drug shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i sku phun tshogs bshad pa/ ye shes phun tshogs bshad pa/ yon tan phun tshogs bshad pa/ phrin las phun tshogs bshad pa/ zhing khams dang gleng gzhi'i khyad par bstan pa/ khyad par ga'an yang rgya cher bstan pa'o/ /dang po la drug theg chen thun mong ba la grags pa'i sku'i dbye ba/thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags kyi sku'i dbye ba/ de dag 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul/ longs spyod rdzogs pa dang sprul sku la bden gnyis su dbye ba/ don dam bden pa nyid gnas lugs kyi sku bzhir bzhugs tshul/ chos nyid kyi sku lnga dang rigs drug la rmongs mi rmongs kyi khyad par bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ gshis lugs zab mo'i sku gcig tu bab tshul/bden pa gnyis kyi sku gnyis su dbye ba/ bden gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i sku gsam tu dbye ba'o/ / than mong ma yin pa gsang sags kyi sku'i dbye ba la ri ring riri byi //byingaganyis/ sku gcig nas lnga'i bar du dbye ba dang / de rang bzhin gyi rigs dang don gcig tshul lo/ /don dam bden pa nyid gnas lugs kyi sku bzhir 438

bzhugs tshul la/ bstan pa/ bshad pa/ bsdu ba gsum las/dang po la gnyis/ gnas lugs zab mo'i sku bzhi bstan pa dang /de gzugs kyi sku ma yin par bstan pa'o/ /rgyas bshad la bcu/ 1 gnas lugs de nyid sku bzhi dang bcu drug la sogs par bzhugs tshul/ 2 de nyid sku lnga ye shes lnga'i bdag tu kun la khyab par bzhugs tshul/ 3 de nyid phyogs dang bral ba'i myang 'das de kho na nyid bzhugs tshul/ 4 de nyid 'dus ma byas kyi dga' ba bzhi dang bcu drug tu yang bzhugs tshul/ 5 de nyid sku'i rab tu dbye ba bcu drug tu yang bzhugs tshul/ 6 de nyid rnam thar bzhi dang rnal 'byor bzhi la sogs par yang bzhugs tshul/ 7 de nyid thams cad mkhyen pa la sogs pa sku bzhi'i rnam grangs dang mkhyen pa bzhir yang bzhugs tshul/ 8 de nyid mngon par byang chub pa bzhi dang don kun gzigs pa la sogs pa bzhir yang bzhugs tshul/ 9 de rnams thams cad lus kyi 'khor lo bzhi la bzhugs tshul/10 'khor lo bzhir dbugs kyi rgyun 'gags pas de rnams thob tshul lo/ /dgu pa de rnams thams cad lus 'khor lo la bzhugs tshul la bcu bdun/ de rnams nyid brjod du med pa'i ā li ka li la sogs par bzhugs tshul/ de rnams nyid 'gyur med yongs grub kyi sku bzhir yang bzhugs tshul/de rnams nyid gnas skabs gzhan don dam gyi gnas skabs bzhir yang bzhugs tshul/ de rnams nyid stong gzhi don dam gzhan stong gi rdo rje bzhir yang bzhugs tshul/ de rnams nyid chos sku'i e waṃ ma ya dang yum bzhir yang bzhugs tshul/ de rnams nyid skad cig gzhan dpe bral dbu ma'i skad cig ma bzhir yang bzhugs tshul/ de rnams nyid dga' ba gzhan rang bzhin 'gyur med kyi dga' ba bzhir yang bzhugs tshul/ de rnams nyid bden bzhi gzhan chos sku'i bden pa bzhir yang bzhugs tshul/ de rnams nyid 439

gnas lugs bde gshegs snying po'i de kho na nyid bzhir yang bzhugs tshul/de rnams nyid de bzhin nyid kyi ngar byed pa dang sgra brjod pa la sogs pa bzhir yang bzhugs tshul/ de rnams nyid sde ba gzhan chos nyid kyi sde ba bzhir yang bzhugs tshul/ de rnams nyid rang bzhin gnyug ma'i zla nyi sgra gcan la sogs par yang bzhugs tshul/ de rnams nyid 'pho ba gzhan 'gal 'du skyon med kyi 'pho ba bcu drug la sogs par bzhugs tshul/ de rnams nyid thun mtshams gzhan rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi thun mtshams bzhir yang bzhugs tshul/ de rnams nyid kun spyod gzhan rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi kun spyod bzhir yang bzhugs tshul/ de rnams nyid don dam 'gog bden kyi byang chub phyogs chos rnams su yang bzhugs tshul/ de rnams kyi don bsdus te thams cad la bden gnyis rnam dbye shes dgos par gdams pa'o /shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i ye shes phun tshogs bshad pa la gsum/ rang byung gzhan byung gi ye shes mdor bstan pa/ de dag so sor phye ste rgyas par bshad pa/ de dag gi khyad par gsung rab dang mthun tshul lo/ /bar ba la gnyis/ gzhan byung ye shes rgyu dang bcas pa bshad pa/rang byung ye shes rgyu med rkyen med bshad pa'o/ / 'di la bdun/ phung po gzhan rang bzhin gyis 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phung po rnams ye shes lngar bzhugs tshul/ gzugs gzhan gzugs chen po la sogs pa rgyal ba rnams su bzhugs tshul/ khams gzhan chos nyid gnyug ma'i khams rnams bde bar gshegs ma rnams su bzhugs tshul/ don dam pa'i mtshan brjod kyis rang byung ye shes lnga rgyas par bstan tshul/ stong pa chen po yi ge lngas kyang rang byung ye shes lnga gsal bar bstan tshul/ thig le stong pa 'gyur med drug kyang de dang dbyer med par bstan pa/ de rnams nyid dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la 440

sogs par yang bzhugs tshul lo/ /de dag gi khyad par gsung rab dang mthun tshul la bzhi/ sangs rgyas ltar ye shes la yang bden gnyis kyi rnam dbye shes dgos par bstan pa/ bden gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i ye shes de dag yongs grub gnyis dang don gcig tu bstan pa/ yang de dag nyid de bzhin nyid dang yang dag ye shes kyi don du yang gnas tshul/ des na sangs rgyas la bden gnyis kyi ye shes dgu'am bcu bzhi mnga' bar bstan pa'o/ /shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i yon tan phun tshogs bshad pa la lnga/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams bden gnyis su bsdus te bshad pa dngos/ de las 'phros pa'i brgal lan gyis dgongs pa zab mo phye ste bstan pa/ theg chen la thun mong du grags pa'i sku gsum gyi shes byed dang yon tan bstan pa/ yon tan gyi khyad par rmad du byung ba gzhan yang bstan pa/ de thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab cing ngo mtshar bar bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ don dam chos sku'i yon tan dang / kun rdzob gzugs sku'i yon tan no/ / de las 'phros pa'i brgal lan gyis dgongs pa zab mo phye ste bstan pa la lnga/ sangs rgyas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang khas len med pa'i dgongs pa bshad pa/ gnas lugs la yongs gcod du grub pa'i chos med par 'dod pa spang / myang 'das chen po 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi don du bstan/ de yang 'gal 'dus skyon med phung po gsum pa'i don du bstan/ de ltar shes na rgyal sras dgongs chen mthong ba'i rtags su bshad pa'o/ /shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i phrin las phun tshogs bshad pa la gsum/ phrin las dang de'i 'byung gnas mdor bstan pa/ dpe dang bcas te rgyas par bshad pa/ dpe shin tu mang pos rab tu rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /khyad par gzhan yang rgya cher bstan pa la bcu drug gzhi 'bras ngo bo dbyer med la 441

rtsod pa spangs nas sku gnyis thob tshul bstan pa/ dri ma sbyong tshul dang sa lam bgrod tshul bsdus te bstan pa/ sa lam bgrod pa la dbugs kyi rgyun 'gag dgos par bstan pa/ de 'gag pas mthar thug gi gnas gyur zab mo thob tshul/ de thob pa'i tshe sbyang bya dri ma zad kyang sbyang gzhi snying po mi zad par bstan pa/ de dag zad mi zad kyi dpe rnams las nam mkha' nyid mchog tu bstan pa/ sbyang gzhi mi zad par grub pas ye shes rgyun chad par 'dod pa la sogs pa yang khegs par bstan pa/ 'khrul ba zad pa'i ye shes la 'khrul snang 'di mi 'char bar bstan pa/ de tsam gyi chad par lta ba'i skyon du yang mi 'gyur bar bstan pa/ 'khrul pa zad pa la mi snang yang ma zad pa la snang ba mi 'gal bar bstan pa/ ye shes la snang ba de rnam shes la mi snang zhing rnam shes la snang ba de ye shes la mi snang bar bstan pa/ ye shes des don la med pa'i khams gsum 'di gzigs na don la gnas pa'i chos nyid mi gzigs par ha cang thal ba/ rnam shes las ma 'das pa'i khams gsum 'di snang na de rnam shes las ma 'das par ha cang thal ba/ yang dag ma yin pa'i khams gsum 'di snang na de yang dag mthong ba'i ye shes ma yin par ha cang thal ba/ sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'di snang na srid pa'i sa bon dang gnyis snang rnams ma 'gags par ha cang thal ba/ de rnams la skyon med skyon du mthong ba'i log rtog bsal ba'o/ /'di la bcu gsum/ lung dang 'gal bar 'khrul ba'i log rtog dgod pa/ mi 'gal bar lung nyid kyis legs par sgrub pa/ des ma mthong ba nyid mthong bar gsungs pa'i dgongs pa yang gsal bar gyur tshul/ lhag mthong yod med kyi snang tshul yang mi gcig par bstan pa/ mkhyen pa la chos de snang dgos na ha cang thal bas gnod tshul/ ye shes la chos nyid mi snang ba la sogs par 'khrul pa'i 'khrul gzhi bstan pa/ don la gnas pa bstan pas log rtog gzhan yang 442

sel tshul/ lung gis mi gnod kyang gnod par 'khrul pa'i log rtog bsal ba/ des na sems can la snang ba bzhin sangs rgyas la snang na ha cang thal ba/ des na las snang khams gsum pa 'di gnas lugs la snang ba tsam du yang ma grub pa/ gnas lugs la mi snang yang 'khrul lugs 'a snang ba mi 'gal bar bstan pa/ mnyam gzhag rigs pa'i shes pa la gang snang de don dam du bstan pa/ mnyam par ma gzhag pa'i go skabs sangs rgyas la mi srid par bstan pa'o/ /'bras bu'i skabs so/ /sa bcad ces pa gzhung don tshan tshan du/ / bsdus nas 'byed pa sdong chen lta bu yin/ /de yi yal ga so sor gyes pa la/ /yi ge grangs mnyam dgos zhes mkhas gzhan bzhed/ /de dang rjes mthun bdag gis gzhan du bkod/ /'dir ni rje btsun dag gi zhal snga nas/ / tshig la ma rton don la rton cig ces/ /legs par gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa yin/ / gtso bo'i don de dngos su smos pa yis/ /'khor du gzhan yang zhor la 'byung srid mod/ /gtso bo de nyid smos pa mkhas pa'i lugs/ / sla ba'i gnas su phra mor ma phye yang /blo ldan rnams la gegs su 'gyur ba med/ /'dir 'bad dge ba rgya chen rab dkar des/ / 'khrul ba thams cad myur du rab 'gags te/ / ma 'khrul gnas lugs zab mo myur thob shog / ri chos nges don rgya mtsho'i sa bcad 'di yang rton pa bzhi ldan gyis mdzad pa'o/ / bswe dgon phyogs rgyal gling du shrī'i ming gis par du bskrun pa'i nges don bstan pa phyogs bcur dar bar shog /443

)tsho/ /grub mtha'i snying thigs/na mo gu ru buddhā bo dhi sa twa ārya ga ṇi bhyaḥ/ gdod ma'i sangs rgyas mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde gshegs snying po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun khyab chos sku de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid kyi bzhugs tshul rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi mkhyen pa'i dngos/ /brtse ldan dol po ba la gsol ba 'debs/ /yang gcig gsol ba 'debs so nges don gyi/ /chos 'di srid gsum kun tu dar bar shog / klu rgyal rgya mtsho'i gting nas mtho ris 'dzeg / tshangs pa'i rnam 'phrul sa 'og bar du 'bab/ /bcom ldan sa steng bzhugs nas srid gsum khyab/ /rigs dang chos sku rang bzhin gsum gyi dpe/ /sangs rgyas rigs la de 'dras nyer btags pa/ /kun rdzob gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas thabs yin/ /chos dang chos nyid dbye ba mi 'byed par/ /sems sam sems can sangs rgyas rigs su 'dod/ /nges pa'i don du rigs mchog chos kyi dbyings/ /rnam shes brgyad po ye shes rnam bzhi dang / /chos dbyings dag pa gnyis ldan ye shes dang / /phung po lnga yang ye shes rnam lnga dang / sngags kyi theg par de dag rigs lnga dang / /dbang po yul bcas sems dpa' yab yum dang / /'byung ba rnam lnga bcom ldan 'das ma dang / /lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs gsum dang / /bzhi pa'i thig le ye shes rdo rje sogs/ /gnas 'gyur dbye ba rnam pa du ma dang / /sgrib bral dbye ba'ang ji snyed gsungs gyur pa/ /gnas gyur thams cad kun rdzob kho na'i yin/ / sgrib bral zhes pa gnyis ku'i phyogs la brten/ /dngos rgyun gcig la mtshan nyid ngan pa dor/ /bzang po'i gnas skabs 'dzin pa gnas gyur te/ sra ba'i dngos po gcig la lcags kyi mdog /spangs nas gser du gyur pa lta bu yin/ /sgrib bral zhes pa dngos de 444

ma 'gyur yang / /phyi rol sgrib byed glo bur spangs pa'i don/ /rang bzhin mi 'gyur don dam phyogs yin te/ /glo bur spangs pa kun rdzob phyogs la brten/ /gnas 'gyur la ni 'gyur bar byed po dang / /sgrib bral la yang bral byed lam yin te/ /de yang gzhi 'bras gnyis dang mthun pa zhig /bsgoms na nges pa'i don gyi lam du 'gyur/ /mi rtag sdug bsngal tshad med bzhi la sogs/ /dmigs pa kun rdzob yin yang de kho na/ / cung zad yid la byed phyir 'dres mar yod/ /de bzhin bskyed rim phra thig las rgya sogs/ /phal cher mos pa yid byed drang don lam/ /'on kyang cha shas tsam gyis nges don 'dres/ /de phyir gnas lugs rtogs pa'i ring rgyu yin/ /rjes dpag rig pas dpyad pa'i stong nyid dang / / kun rdzob rang sor 'jog pa'i rtog med kyang / / don spyi tsam dang dngos la dmigs pa'i phyir/ /nges don de nyid kho na yid byed min/ /rang bzhin bde gshegs snying po bsgom pa dang / /khyad chos rgyal ba'i yon tan bsam pa gnyis/ /rnam rtog bral ba'i yid kyis 'go bsdus na/ / de ni nges don bde gshegs lam mchog yin/ / kun rdzob gzhi de 'bras bu'i kun rdzob dang / /'dra bar gnas pa'ang lam gnyis rgyas par byed/ /don dam la ni 'phel 'grib med mod kyi/ /sgrib g.yogs bral bar byed pa'ang sgom 'di yin/ /gzhi dang 'bras bu 'dra chos yod pas na/ /gzhi la bcos na de rgyun 'bras bur 'gyur/ /gser bye mchod sdong rang bzhin 'dra ba la/ /bcos pas sngar gyi mchod sdong 'dra bar 'byung / /de bzhin rnam shes ye shes phyogs 'dra dang / rnam shes thabs kyis bsgyur na sngar yod kyi/ / ye shes rnams dang 'dra bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /rigs zhes zer te kun rdzob kho na'i yin/ / nyer len rgyu dang rigs mthun 'dra chos rigs/ /de sgra phyogs mthun de yi rang bzhin dang / /de dang de dbyer med la rigs so zhes/ /'jog pa 'di ni don dam phyogs la'o/ /don dam rigs ni skyed byed don min te/ /rgyu yi ming yang rang bzhin nyid la 'dogs/ /nye ring med pa'i dbyings de rgyu dang rigs/ /gcig nyid blo la 'dra bar snang ba yin/ / 'jig rten na yang gcig la 'dra ba'i sgra/ /yod phyir tha snyad tshul dang 'gal ba min/ /'di rgyu gser las grub ces zer ba ltar/ /chos dbyings de ni rang bzhin phyir na rgyu/ /chu shing snying po med la 'bras snying dpe/ / thos dang zag med sa bon gsal stong rig / de yi 'khor ba zad na mi slob 445

lam/ /'di la'ang kun rdzob nyid las snying por btags/ /zhes pa ni rigs kyi rnam par ga'ag pa'o/ /yang gcig shes rab rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal/ /snying por sangs rgyas bzhugs tshul 'dir bshad bya/ /don dam snying po gtan la 'bebs pa na/ /go bas blo yi rtogs tshul rnam pa gnyis/ / bral 'bras chos sku 'bras bur smos ci dgos/ /lam dang 'khor ba'i chos la mar 'gribs dang / / gzhi yi chos nyid 'khor bar smos ci dgos / / lam dang 'bras bu la yang yar snyog go /sangs rgyas ye shes sems can tshogs zhugs ni/ /tshangs pa'i sprul ba sa la 'bab pas mtshon/ / skabs 'dir don gyi gtso bo 'di yin te/ / bcom ldan shākya seng ge'i chos sku de/ / sangs rgyas yon tan kun gyi rgyan dang ldan/ /bdag gi lus ngag yid la de nyid khyab/ /lus ngag yid ni log snang 'khrul snang tsam/ /bag chags yid kyis 'khrul ba'i snang ba bskyed/ /sgyu ma'i rgyu las sgyu ma'i 'bras bu byung / /snang tshul kho na yin gyi gnas tshul min/ /bdag la khyab pa'i shāka thub chos sku de/ /'gro la snang tshul ma yin gnas tshul yin/ /bdag rang med pa'i gnas na de nyid yod/ / bdag ni 'khrul snang de ni ma 'khrul ba/ / bdag ni rdzun pa de ni bden par grub/ /bdag ni sdug bsngal de ni bde ba'i mchog / bdag ni mi rtag de ni rtag pa'i gtso/ / bdag ni kun btags de ni yo/ngas grub yin/ / shāka thub chos sku de ni sangs rgyas dngos/ /sangs rgyas 'phrin las thams cad de yi yin/ /stobs bcu mi 'jigs la sogs lta ci smos/ /mtshan dpe la sogs yon tan kun dang ldan/ /de la sku yod gsung dang thugs kyang yod/ /sku gang yin pa gsung dang thugs kyang yin/ /bdag dang bdag la bzhugs pa'i shāka thub de/ /g.ya' dang gser gyi tshul du gnas pa yin/ /na bun ri bo'i dpe yis mtshon pa yin/ /de la sogs pa dpe ni mtha' yas yod/ / bdag la de 'dra'i shāka thub bzhugs pa de/ /bdag gis ma mthong grogs kyis mi mthong la/ /'khor ba'i sems can kun gyis mthong mi 'gyur/ /nyan thos sogs kyis dad pas rtogs bya tsam/ / sa bdun gnas pas kyang ni mngon sum min/ / mdzod nang nor bzhin phyogs mgo things pa tsam/ /dag sar gnas pas zur tsam 'ol spyi tsam/ /mtha' dag ma lus gzigs pa sangs rgyas nyid/ /chos sku de ni gdod nas spros dang bral/ /spros dang bral 446

ngo shes pas bden par grub/ /ci yang min pa'i spros bral zhes bya ba/ /yid la byas na rtag tu spros pa yin/ nam yang blos ma byas par grol 'gyur na/ /'khor ba snod bcud thams cad rang grol 'gyur/ /don spyi sgom pa thams cad rtog par zad/ /spros med dngos ni rang rig ye shes so/ /de ltar bdag la de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /shākya thub pa mnyam par bzhag pa bzhugs/ /rnal 'byor mchog dang ldan pas sangs rgyas mthong / /'di thos rtog ge pa rnams khro zhing 'khrugs/ /tshangs par gyur kyang chos spong las kyis bsregs/ /de bas grong pa'i skye bo phal pa ru/ /ji ltar bdag la shākya'i rgyal po yi/ /ye shes sku de bzhugs pa ji bzhin du/ /pha ma phu nu 'khor g.yog kun la'ang yod/ /gnyen la de yod dgra la de yod de/ /lha dang dmyal ba dud 'gro kun la'ang yod/ /'gro drug sems can kun la'ang de 'dra bzhugs/ / byung dang 'byung 'gyur sems can thams cad la'ang / /lha mo sgyu 'phrul sras de rtag tu bzhugs/ /rnal 'byor can 'gas de dag so sor mthong / / sangs rgyas nyid kyis gzigs na thams cad gcig / bdag la bzhugs pa'i gau haṃ de kho na/ /sems can kun la khyab par bzhugs pa yin/ /gzhan la bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan bde gshegs las/ / gzhan pa bdag la'ang med de ngo bo gcig /chos sku shin tu rgya che sna tshogs 'di/ /de yi khongs su chud par gyur na yang / /chos rnams kun gyi nang na de mchog phyir/ /gtso dang gces pa'i don gyi snying po yin/ /shes bya kun la nye ring med phyir dang / chos rnams thams cad gnas tshul gcig phyir dang / sems las gzhan du phyi rol med phyir dang / / sems kyi chos nyid sems la khyab pa'i phyir/ /bdag la bzhugs pa'i nyi ma'i gnyen mchog de/ /brtan g.yo srid zhi kun la khyab pa yin/ /bgrod bya lam lnga sa bcu kun la khyab/ /bsgom bya byang phyogs phar phyin kun la khyab/ /phung po khams dang skye mched kun la khyab/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis bden pa rnam bzhi dang / /rags dang phra ba mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum sogs/ /kun gyi srog dang dwangs mar 'di nyid bzhugs/ /shākya'i rigs kyi thig le'i chos sku de/ /bcom ldan 'od srung chos sku gzhan phod min/ /rnam gzigs mar me mdzad kyi'ang de kho na/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi chos sku de/ / bcom ldan shuka thub ba'i chos sku yin/ /bde gshegs gau haṃ chen po'i chos sku las/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas chos sku gzhan yod 447

min/ /'od dpag med dang mi 'khrugs la sogs pa/ /da lta'i sangs rgyas kun gyi chos sku dang / /byams pa snang mdzad la sogs ma 'ongs pa'i/ /rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku'ang de dang 'dra/ /kun rdzob sangs rgyas dus gsum byung ba rnams/ /lam bden nyid yin de dag thams cad kyi/ /spyi nor don dam chos kyi sku yin pas/ /chos sku gnyis su med de kun la khyab/ /chos sku 'di ni 'das pa'i dus tshad yod/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis 'di mngon mdzad/ /'das pa'i dus kyiru 'di la ma gos pas/ da ltar phyi ma'i dus la 'di nyid gnas/ /'das dus bzhin du dus gnyis po la'ang sbyar/ /dus tshad kun na yod kyang dus spangs pa/ / da lta'i sangs rgyas kun gyis 'di rtogs shing / / ma byon sangs rgyas kun gyis shāka thub kyi/ /chos sku 'di nyid mngon du mdzad 'gyur gyi/ /chos sku gzhan zhig mngon du 'gyur ba min/ / dus la ji bzhin phyogs la'ang sbyar bya ste/ /yul tshad kun la yong kyang yul dang bral/ /sangs rgyas skyes bu ji snyed thams cad kyi/ /spyi nor yin pas shākya seng ge yang / / yin phyir shāka thub chos sku zhes su grags/ / de bzhin sangs rgyas kun la'ang bsgre bar bya/ /spyi nor de ni brtan thub nor gyi mchog /sgos nor lam bden chos rnams ya ma brla/ /de phyir shes bya kun gyi gnas tshul ni/ /shāka thub yin te 'od srung sogs kyang yin/ / sangs rgyas gcig kyang yin la kun kyang yin/ /chos rnams kun gyi gnas tshul sangs rgyas yin/ /de ni gtsang bde rtag bdag pha rol phyin/ /'bras bu'i sangs rgyas zer yang gnas lugs yin/ /snod bcud 'khor 'das rten 'brel chos rnams kun/ / rang tshugs mi thub bdag med snang tshul tsam/ /sangs rgyas de yi 'od kyis dge blo 'byung / / dge ba rgyas pas 'khrul snang rang sar sangs/ / de tshe sangs rgyas skyes bu chos skur reg/ de la snang tshul gnas tshul tha dad med/ /rang snang dang po grol lam khyad par bcas/ /de rjes chos sku'i ngo bor de nyid thim/ / de nas gzhan snang gzugs sku rtag tu 'byung / / gzugs sku gnyis dang lam bden gyis bsdus pa'i/ /bde gshegs de ni sangs rgyas tsam po ba/ /sangs rgyas dngos rang de ni chos sku'o/ /ces pa ni sangs rgyas nyid snying por rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /da dung kun mkhyen che la gsol ba 'debs/ /blo yi rtogs tshul gnyis pa 'di ltar go / rang bzhin dri med de ni gnyis med de/ /bcom ldan sa steng bzhugs pa'i dpe 448

dang 'dra/ /bum pa'i rang bzhin chos nyid ces bya ba/ /gdod nas gzung 'dzin gnyis bral ye shes te/ /de ni don dam de ni stong nyid dang / /de ni brjod bral de ni spros bral dang / /de ni mtha' bral rang bzhin sher phyin no/ / de ni rtag chad mtha' las gdod nas 'das/ / yod mtha' med mtha' yin min mtha' dang bral/ / rgyu 'bras ma yin gcig min du ma min/ /yul dang yul can dbye ba 'di la med/ /rtogs bya rtogs byed rim pa kun bral yang / /ci med cang med ci yang ma yin tsam/ /gang du'ang mi gnas tsam gyi stong nyid min/ /de 'dra yin na dngos med tsam du 'gyur/ /de yang 'dod na mngon sum rtogs mi srid/ /rtog pas rtogs na spros pa'i tha shal yin/ /ma rtogs par 'dod 'bad pa don med 'gyur/ / de phyir 'di ni spros kun gyis dben pa'i/ / rang rig rang gsal gdod ma gcig tu yod/ /de yi khyad par rnam pa thams cad pa/ /srid 'das kun gyi rnam pa yod tshad du/ /gdod nas rtag tu cig car shar bzhin pa/ /shar yang de rnams kun gyis ma gos pa/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i yul spangs kyang / /ye shes gzugs sogs kun tu yod yod pa/ /mig sogs dbang po'i lus ni spangs gyur kyang / /don dam mig sogs kun tu gnas gnas pa/ /tshogs brgyad sems byung rnam rtog kun bral yang / /chos nyid rig pa mtha' yas shar shar ba/ /de sogs shes bya kun la sbyar bar bya/ /rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med par dgongs/ /phyogs kyis ma gos dus kyis ma gos kyang / /phyogs dus kun gyi rnam pa 'char ba'i phyir/ /dus gsum dus med rtogs pa'i ye shes so/ /dus rnams kun tu byung yang rtag pa dang / rnam pa kun tu byung yang spros bral ba/ /'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab mtshan nyid te/ /'phags mchog rnams kyis mngon sum nyid du gzigs/ / rgya bod yul gyi skal chad thos rlom can/ /thams cad 'di thos tsam na snying khrag bskams/ / de phyir ri chos gsang ba zab mo yin/ /srid tshad kun gyi rnam par gnas pa'i phyir/ /skyob pa kun gyi yon tan 'di la yod/ /'di nyid bde gshegs chos sku dngos nyid yin/ /bde gshegs snying po yon tan can zhes bya/ /bum pa'i dngos la bde gshegs snying po bzhugs/ /gnas tshul chos nyid de yin bum pa min/ /bum pa zhes pa nam yang yod ma myong / /bum par snang ba de ni 'khrul snang tsam/ /de yi shul na gnyis med ye shes yod/ /de ni rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung 449

drung nyid/ /bum pa'i chos dbyings de ltar yin pa bzhin/ / ka ba sogs kyi dbyings kyang de dang 'dra/ /de yi rigs pas 'byung ba 'byung gyur dang / / gtso bo rnam shes 'khor dang bcas pa dang / /yul dus skye 'gag la sogs chos kun gyi/ /rang bzhin gnas lugs bde bar gshegs pa yin/ /de ltar yin na sems can thams cad kyi/ /gnas lugs bde gshegs yin pa smos ci dgos/ /gnas lugs gzung 'dzin gnyis bral ye shes kyi/ /cha nas 'phags mchog kun gyis gcig tu gzigs/ /de nyid yon tan can gyi snying po ru/ /gzigs pa rnams la'ang so sor snang ba yod/ /sgrib kun bral na tha dad snang ba med/ /so sor snang ba thams cad 'khrul pa ste/ /shes bya 'i sgrib pa yin pas de zad na/ /rang snang nyid la chos sku las gzhan med/ /sangs rgyas ye shes kho na'i spyod yul na/ /sangs rgyas las gzhan snang ba cung zad med/ /de nyid phyin ci ma log rang snang ste/ /chos sku las gzhan gang mthong log snang yin/ /bdag gzhan 'khor ba'i chos nyid gang yin pa/ /nges par yod kyang mthong ba ma yin pas/ /sbas pa'i tshul du 'dug phyir snying por 'dod/ / de ni sems can rnams kyi rgyu mtshan la/ /brten nas snying por 'jog tshul gcig yin no/ /chos nyid dge ba yin pas dge sems 'byung / /lam rnams 'di las byung zhing 'di yis khyab/ / shes bya kun gyi chos kyi dbyings 'di la/ /rtogs pa po ni sangs rgyas kho na'i phyir/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi chos skur mtshan yang gsol/ /dam pa'i don gyi sems can sangs rgyas gcig / lus ngag yid gsum 'dus pa'i phung po ni/ / brda' tsam dbang gis kun rdzob sems can te/ /skyes bur 'jog pa kun rdzob sgo nas brjod/ /chos can ming gis sbyor na kun rdzob gtso/ /sangs rgyas sogs la don dam gtso bor rig /rdzogs sangs rgyas la kun rdzob mi snang yang / /rnam pa thams cad nyid kyis ji snyed mkhyen/ /'khor 'das de bzhin nyid dbyer med ces pa/ /phan tshun 'dra ba tsam la 'jog pa 'khrul/ /dngos med yin na ldog rkyang tsam du zad/ /de la tha dad 'dra mtshan ji bzhin med/ / gal te dngos yin ngo bo tha dad na/ /rnam pa kun tu 'dra ba srid ma yin/ /ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis kyang de nyid 'di/ /mi rtag du ma nyid la shin tu 'gal/ /dri bcas 'khor ba la 'brel zhi la med/ /dri med srid la nam yang ma 'brel na/ / snga ma ci bzhin phyi ma gang na ci/ / dri bcas dri med 450

dngos tha dad phyir ro/ /skad cig yin na dus tshod so sor 'brel/ /so so la yang rang ngo tha dad phyir/ /phan tshun mtshan nyid mi 'dra du mas gos/ /phan tshun ji bzhin 'dra zhes zer ba blun/ /khyad par mi 'dra ci yang mi srid na/ /de ni ngo bo gcig pa'i ngan rtags yin/ /'dra bzhin mnyam mtshungs thal ches gcig tu go / chos dbyings gdod nas dri med dri bral yin/ /de bzhin nyid la dri bcas nam yang med/ /sems can la bltos dri bcas rnam gzhag tsam/ /dag pa gnyis ldan zhes byar don la med/ / sangs rgyas skyes bu'i ngos nas bzhag pa tsam/ /chos kyi dbyings la 'khor 'das yod min pas/ /dri mas bcings dang gsar du grol ba med/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos kun 'a// /chos sku 'di ni mgon du yod pa'i phyir/ /btags ngor de bzhin nyid la gnyis so zhes/ dpyad pa med pa'i tshul du 'jog pa yin/ /ngo bo gcig dang tha dad 'a sa grol kyang /du mar med phyir gcig gi ming 'jug pa/ /de bzhin nyid de shes bya kun la khyab/ /kun gyi spyi la bzhugs pa nyid kyi phyir/ /lha mi dud 'gro ri dang thang la sogs/ /so so tha dad bye brag snang grags pa/ /re re kun gyi'ang de bzhin nyid du 'gyur/ /'on kyang so sor med de spyi la khebs/ /rtag nyid phyir na dus gsum kun khyab cing / /cha med nyid phyir yul kun cig car khyab/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi de bzhin nyid gang yin/ /sems can kun gyi'ang de bzhin nyid du yod/ / de phyir sems can snying po can du gsungs/ /dngos kyi sangs rgyas de bzhin nyid phyir ro/ /de bzhin nyid de 'gyur med rtag pa'i phyir/mngon du gyur ram ma gyur gang yin yang / /snying po nyid de sra ba'i don phyir ro/ /ces pa ni de bzhin nyid rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /slar yang rton pa bzhi ldan la phyag 'tshal/ /rigs nyid phyir na rigs de 'phel ba'i phyir/ /drang don thabs kyi lam la 'jug kyang dgos/ /spyod pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo yang de/ / sangs rgyas khyab pa'i phyir na rjes dran bsgom/ /yon tan mtha' yas de las mos pa skye/ 'khor 'das kun la de bzhin nyid gcig pas/ /dmigs pa tha dad med de chos dbyings nyid/ /chos la mos pas sangs rgyas rjes dran bsgom/ /de yang snying por yon tan nges pa yin/ /chos nyid yul du byed pa shes rab dang / /de bsgom mnyam gzhag rjes thob gnyis su dbye/ / mnyam gzhag zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 451

'jug /zhi lhag gnyis kur rtog bral ma 'khrul ba/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa'i sgo nas dbye ba yod/ / rjes thob rang bzhin snang ba'i dbye ba shes/ / kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu gtso bor bsgom/ /shes rab bsam gtan zhes bya de la 'dus/ /mnyam gzhag rjes thob gnyis kur snying rje che/ /phal cher de yi spyod pa rjes thob na'o/ /'di la rnam kun rdzogs pa'i sgrub pa dang / /cha shas tsam la dpyad kyang don ldan 'gyur/ /rtsa ba'i tshul khrims byang sdom spyod la gnas/ /thub pa'i bstan la so sor thar pa bzhin/ /de yang de yi sngon 'gro rten du gyur/ /gal te gsang ba'i theg pa la mos na/ /dam tshig gis ni de nyid mchog tu byed/ /rgyal ba'i gsung la yid ches mos ldan pas/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa rgyun mi 'chad/ /rjes dran gzhan dag de yi rjes 'gro nyid/ /chos nyid don la rnam par mi rtog pa'o/ /gal te mtshan mar 'dzin na gnyen po bsten/ / snang bar bcas dang snang ba med par spyod/ /'gro kun bde gshegs snying po can yin pas/ / gang zag med cing phung sogs chos med kyang / /bdag mtshungs byams dang snying rje phyogs med bsgom/ /ji srid 'byung ba yod cing rnam rtog yod/ /de srid brtson 'grus drag pos dge la spyod/ /de nyid gzhan gyi don du byang chub bsngo/ / ring por mi thogs bzod pa thob par 'gyur/ / bsam gtan mchog bzhi rim dang cig car 'grub/ / rang ngam gzhan la sangs rgyas rtag bzhugs na/ /de mi bzhugs par lta ba log lta yin/ /thog med spyan ldan sangs rgyas drung 'dug kyang / /rang gis ma mthong bag med spyod dang mtshungs/ /'gro kun bde gshegs snying po can yin na/ /snying po med snyam skur 'debs chad par lta/ / sems can rgyu yi rigs la dmigs pa dang / / 'bras bu sangs rgyas chos la dmigs nas skur/ rgyu 'bras gnyis ga'i phyogs la skur ba btab/ /dngos la yod kyang med par lta ba ni/ /bden gnyis gnas skabs gang du'ang skur 'debs nyid/ /'gro ba'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas min snyam pa/ / rgyal la rnam mkhyen med par smra dang mtshungs/ /rtag pa 'jig par smra ba chad lta ste/ /cho 'phrul che tshe mu stegs ston pa drug/gau haṃ me yis tshig ces zer dang mtshungs/ / sangs rgyas rtag pa la dang sems can rnams/ /snying po can du smra la skur 'debs pa/ /de dag phal cher mi bzad dmyal bar 'gro/ /'jim gzugs tsam la'ang co 'dri skur 'debs pa/ /de yang ngan 'gror 'gyur 452

na 'dir ci smos/ / sangs rgyas la dmigs 'jig dang sdug bsngal zer/ / rgyu mthun 'bras bu tshe thung ba dang nad/ / de bas sdig lta mi bzad spangs byas nas/ / bde gshegs snying po dad pas rtogs par bya/ /gal te zab mo'i don la mos shing bsgom/ /dag pa'i rtsa ba smin na cig car rtogs/ /gzhan du rnam kun spyod pas rim gyis thob/ /cha shas kyis kyang don chen 'gyur ba ste/ / sngon du mtshams med byas pa'ang 'di yis grol/ /sdig la spyod bzhin pa yang 'dir dad na/ /rnam smin ring du skrod cing zad par byed/ /bag med srid pa'i dbang gyur yul lnga la/ / rtag tu bsten pa'ang mi 'ching grol ba yod/ /brtul zhugs nyams pa'ang lha yul 'gro ba dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku yi snang ba 'byung / /'di la dad pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /sman dang sngags kyi sbyor ba 'ga' yis kyang / /lan rer sdig can mtho ris gnas 'gro srid/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan bsam yas la mos na/ /phan yon de dag ci phyir 'byung mi 'gyur/ /kun mkhyen mchog de'i bzhed dgongs 'khrul med 'di/ / gzhan gyis ji bzhin smra ba ma byung ngo/ /rig 'dzin theg par sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ / 'phrin las rnams kyi rnam pa mtha' yas bsgom/ /snang med tsam zhig chos sku yin gyur na/ /de kun log pas rnam par brtags par 'gyur/ / bcos ma'i rim pas gzugs sku lam du byed/ /'on kyang ji bzhin ma yin rjes mthun tsam/ /grub pa'i rim pas sku gsungs thugs rnam pa/ /'di dag gtso bor chos sku lam du byed/ /las dang pos kyang snying po cung zad mthong / /gsang sngags thun mong min pa'i thabs las so/ /las rlung rnam rtog gcig tu 'jug pa ni/ /ji ltar rigs par 'gog pa thabs kyi mchog / rtog dang rtsol ba'i gzhan dbang dang bral ba/ /snang brnyan sgra dbyangs bde stong chos skur mtshungs/ /de phyir chos sku lam du byed par nus/ /'ga' zhig don dam chos sku'i snang ba nyid/ /kha cig nyams snang yin yang de yi lam/ /mnyam gzhag de dang rdo rje slob dpon mchog / mchod cing mnyes pas tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs nas/ /gdod ma'i rdo rje bzhi po mngon du 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas skyes bu gcig gis chos dbyings rtogs/ /de rgyu nyid las sems can mtha' yas la /gang 'dul 'phrin las mkha' khyab rtag tu 'jug / nyi dang 'od zer bzhin du lhun gyis grub/ /ces pa ni nges par 'byung ba dang 'byin pa gtan la dbab pa'o/ /453

da ltar sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes nyid/ /shes bya kun la khyab cing bzhugs pa'i phyir/ /de nyid chos dbyings yin te bdag la sogs/ /srog ldan kun la'ang mgon dang bcud du bzhugs/ /de ni spros bral yin phyir rgyu 'bras min/ /'on kyang de yod na ni 'khor 'das 'byung / / med na min pas kun gzhi ye shes zer/ / de 'dra'i nye ba'i mdangs 'od lam yin te/ /de yang 'khor ba'i chos dang 'dzoms las 'byung / /de lta na yang de yis 'khor ba spong / /gang zag 'khrul ba zad na de 'tshang rgya/ /'khrul spangs gang zag nyid kyang spangs gyur mod/ /snga ma'i shugs las gnas gyur ye shes 'byung / /de ni sangs rgyas skyes bu zhes su brjod/ /rig pa lam gzhan 'dres shing dbyings ni gcig /tshigs bcad 'di bzhi po la don kun tshang / /gzhan smra'i rjes su skyar zlos ma byas par/ /'chad tshul go bde sngon med smra bar spobs/ / nges pa'i don gyi gsang ba zab mo 'di/ gsal zhing ma sbas gol sa chod par smras/ /go ba'i dus na ma 'thor gcig tu 'gril/ /smra ba'i dus na ngag don khar longs shing / /'bel gtam byed na klan ku'i gnas med pa/ /ji bzhin smra ba 'di yang mgon gyi mthu/ / lta ba'i phyogs la mang du bshad zin mod/ /kha chems snying la zhen pa 'di las med/ /spros pa'i chos skad rnam pa sna tshogs rnams/ /lung rigs gnyis dang mthun na gang dgar gyis/ /'di med bshad rlabs bzang yang khog stong yin/ / phyag rgya 'dis btab kun kyang bdud rtsi nyid/ /'dir bshad 'di la dge ba mchis so cog /jo bo sems can don gyi mchog tu bsngo/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i chos thams cad kyi gnad sngon med pa'i bstan bcos yid bzhin nor bu lta bu snying po nges pa ces bya ba 'di ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs rjes mtshams sbyar bas/ /dol po sangs rgyas de'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs te/rgyal ba rgyal sras thams cad kyi dgongs pa'i gnad phyin ci ma log pa la nges pa rnyed nas/ / kha ba can gyi shambha lar thun gcig la nges par brjod pa'o/ / 'dir smras pa/da ni lang tsho yol gyur pas/ /mang du smras pas ci zhig bya/ /gces pa'i snying 'di phyung gyur kyang / /sha dum cir mi rung du zad/ /bcom ldan de la yid ches pas/ /bdag ni srog dang snying dang tshe/ /kun las gces pa gsang ba'i tshig /'di las gzhan du smra rgyu med/ /mkhas sam shin tu blun yang rung / / nus pa ldan nam mi ldan rung / /spyod pa 454

bzang ngam ngan yang rung / /'di bzhin 'bad na don chen thob/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i shes rab yod rlom dang / /zhib tig ngom pa'i mgo mkhregs tshul 'chos dang / /rtsing chos phaṭa ral grub par bkur ba yang / / zab mo 'di ma rtogs pas g.yang sar lhung / /grub mtha' 'di ni mdo rgyud kun gyi don/ /'chad tshul 'di 'dra bdag gi blo la shar/ /'phags mchog kun gyi dgongs pa'ang 'di yin la/ /sngon med legs brjod ces kyang 'gal ba med/ / rgyal ba kun gyi bgrod pa gcig gyur/ / shes bya gshis kyi gnas lugs 'khrul med/ /snying gtam 'di ni de ring bshad do/ / blo sna ma mang rtse gcig sgrubs shig / gcig zhus/ mgo lam̐/ /sarba/ bla ma'i zhal lung rgyal kun thugs kyi gsang / /'dir 'bad dge las skye ba thams cad du/ / 'di nyid thos shing 'di don nyams su myong / /'di nyid rtogs nas kun kyang 'dir 'jug shog / shubham stu sarba dzā ga haṃ/ /dge'o/ /su sti/ /gangs ljongs bstan pa'i mig gcig sgrol mgon rjes/ /dbu ma'i gnad bsdus bstan bcos yid bzhin nor/ / par du bskrun dges yon sbyar gtsug tor gtsos/ /'gro kun sgrib bral sku bzhi'i dpal thob shog / rmad byung tshogs gnyis bsod nams gsags pa'i zhing / /rnga yul thub bstan 'dzin pa'i sde chen por/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal gling du nges don sgo/ /phye bas rgyal bstan snying po rgyas gyur cig / sarba mgau lam̐/ /455

༄7/ /zab mo gzhan stong dbu ma'i bla brgyud gsol 'debs/thog med dus nas byang chub sangs rgyas kyang / 'gro ba'i don du rgyal sras tshul ston pa/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab chen por dbang bskur brnyes/ /mgon po byams pa'i zhabs la gsol 'debs/ /ye shes zhe ba'i 'od byed sa brnyes shing / /mi pham mgon po'i zhal lung bdud rtsi thob/ /'dzam gling 'di na theg chen bstan pa'i bdag /'phags pa thogs med ོ/ /gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin dang gnyis su med/ / ma lus rgyal ba'i bka' rnams thugs su chud/ / sangs rgyas bstan pa'i nyin byed gcig pur gyur/ / rgyal sras dbyig gnyen nga/ /phra zhing rtogs dka' drang srong chen po'i lam/ / bde gshegs snying po'i legs bshad seng ge'i sgra/ / ring nas nub pa slar yang gsal mdzad pa'i/ / kkang mi tre'i ོ/ /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul ba'i dri ma gtan nas spangs/ /brtul zhugs spyod mdzad a wa dhu ti pa/ /mi pham zhal gzigs phyogs kun rgyu ba'i tshul/ /dga' ba grags pa'i nga/ / theg mchog gzhung lugs rgya mcho'i pha rol son/ /tshangs spyod dpal gyis brgyan pa'i dge slong ste/ /gnas lugs zab mo'i don gzigs kha che ba/ /'byung gnas zhi ba'i nga/ /bgrang yas mkhas grub byon pa'i rigs su 'khrungs/ /dpag yas lhag pa'i lha yis byin gyis brlabs/ /mtha' yas gsung 456

rab legs mkhyen rnal 'byor mchog / zam ze sadzdza na la nga/ /bde mchog 'khor lo'i zhal gzigs mkhas pa'i phul/ / phyogs 'dir gzhan stong dbu ma'i sgra bsgrags shing / /dpe med grong du rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa/ /dga' ba'i rdo rje'i ོ/ /mi pham gzhung la mkhas pa'i phul du gyur/ / dbu ma'i lam las chos nyid zab mo gzigs/ sdom brtson dam pa btsan rigs kha bo che/ /dri med shes rab ོ/ /dgra gnyen chags sdang spangs te gzhan yul byon/ /zab mo'i mdo dang rgyud sde du ma mkhyen/ / rgyal tshab byams pas rjes bzung la stod pa/ / dar ma brtson 'grus nga/ / rang byung ye shes cig car thugs la 'khrungs/ / zhal mthong kun yang lam sna zin par grags/ /snying po'i bstan pa gsal mdzad dol ba gnyan/ /ye shes 'byung gnas ོ/ / 'phags mchog gnyis kyi dgongs pa gcig tu gzigs/ / theg chen mngon pa'i bstan pa gsal mdzad pa/ / byang chub skyabs dang gzhon nu byang chub ste/ /'jang ston sku mched nga/ / sdom brtson chos skyong zan du 'khol ba po/ / sde snod 'dzin pa mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/ / phyag rdor zhal gzigs chos rje skyo ston pa/ / smon lam tshul khrims ོ/ / 'phags pa mi g.yo mgon po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bka' dang bstan bcos mtha' dag thugs su chud/ /mkhas pa'i mkhas pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /bcom ldan ral gri'i nga/ / mang thos mthar phyin dam pa'i chos kyi mdzod/ /nyan bshad sgo nas bstan pa nyin mor mdzad/ /che dgus zhabs la btud pa'i bshes gnyen mchog / skyi ston 'jam pa'i dbyangs la ོ/ / gangs ri'i khrod 'dir nges don bstan pa'i bdag / 'gran zad dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /'jig rten dbang po'i rnam 'phrul jo nang ba/ / kun mkhyen chen po'i nga/ / blo gsal 'dus pa dam pa kun gyi rgyan/ / rig pa'i dbang 457

phyug phas rkya rgol ba 'joms/ / mkhas mchog rnams kyi bla ma kun dga' dpal/ /nya dbon chos rje'i nga/ /bla mas byin brlabs 'gro ba'i don chen 'grub/ /snying rje chen pos rgyal ba'i sras su chud/ /bde gshegs snying po'i don la nges pa 'khrungs/ /chos dpal mgon po'i nga/ /'dul mngon rgya mcho'i pha rol son nas kyang / /phyi ma'i dus na gzhung brgya smra ba'i mchog / dam pa'i spyod ldan byang chub thugs gnyis 'byongs/ /blo gros rgya mtsho'i nga/ / zab mo'i don la ting 'dzin brtan pa thob/ / kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bur mngon sum gzigs/ / gnyes 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig pa'i don yod dpal/ /byams mgon gnyis par grags la ོ/ /mdo sngags gzhung lugs nges gsang kun gzigs nas/ /log smra mtha' dag yang dag rigs pas sel/ / bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gnas lnga rig pa'i phul/ / shākya mchog ldan nga/ / mkhas mchog gang de'i gsung gi gsang ba las/ /nam yang g.yo ba med pa'i blo gros can/ /mkhas pa'i dbang phyug 'od gsal rdo rje'i thugs/ /don yod grub pa'i ོ/ /phyogs 'dzin spangs te dam pa'i chos kyi sgo/ / mtha' dag gsan cing thugs su chad gyur nas/ / skal bzang yid kyi re ba skong mdzad pa'i/ /'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bor nga/ /rgyal ba dges pa'i lam las mthar thug brnyes/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i rgya mchor dbang bsgyur pa/ /thar 'dod 'gro ba kun gyi ded dpon mchog / kun dga' rgyal mtshan nga/ /rlabs chen ting 'dzin gzungs dang smon lam gyi/ /chu gter dbus na ye shes ri bo'i rgyal/ /gzhan phan lha dbang tshogs bcas kun gyis bsten/ /grags ldan grub pa mchog la ོ/ / dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pas/ / dus mthar bshes gnyen gzugs kyis 'gro don mdzad/ / dus rnams kun tu 'gro kun thar par 'god/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol 458

ba 'debs/ / stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa dang / zhi lhag ting 'dzin nyams myong gong 'phel gyis/ / gnyis snang 'khrul ba'i dri ma kun bsal nas/ / dri bral bde gshegs snying po mngon 'gyur shog/phyis brgyud pa'i bla ma gzhan 'jug na yang dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs kyi gong du 'jug / dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs kyi blo ka de rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gso'/ 'debs su bya'o/ /ye shes 'byung gnas kyi rjes la dge bshes tho gar gnam lde 'jug pa'ang yod mod mi dgos la/ 'di la brgyud pa'i khyad par gzhan 'jang ston sku mched kyi rjes la zhang mya ngan med lo mchog pa spang lo byang rtse nya dbon sogs ded kyang chog par grags la/thogs med sku mched nye brgyud la mi dgos kyang lugs 'di'i shing rta'i srol 'byed yin pa'i phyir nges par 'jug dgos la/ rnam pa gcig tu ring brgyud la mos na sku mched kyi rjes su blo gros brtan pa/ yon tan blo gros/ gang spel/ dha rma ma ti/ bha bya mi tra/ ratna mi tra/ shanti ba/ mi tri ba rnams brgyud pa yin pas de bzhin 'ded la/yang gzhan stong gi lta ba'i rim pa klu sgrub nas brgyud pa ni/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/phyag na rdo rje/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ klu sgrub/ sha wa ri/ mi tri ba man chad sngar bzhin no/ /'di ni 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa thams cad kyi dgongs don gcig tu dril ba'i smar khrid kyi brgyud pa yin la/ byams chos sde lnga so so'i khrid la brgyud pa tha dad du yod do/ / gzhan stong dbu ma'i lta khrid kyi brgyud 'debs 'di yang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /ga'an stong brgyud 'debs kha skong / lha dbang grags pa'i rjes su/ gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dgongs don rtog /mdo sngags gzhi dbyings mthar thug gcig thag chod/ / bshad sgrub zung gis nges don cher spel mkhan/ gsang bdag sgrol mgon rje la ོ/ /gang gi thugs sras mchog gyur rnal 'byor ma/ /grub brnyes go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa'i phul/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa'i nges gsang 'dzin skyong spel/ / rje btsun 'phrin las dbang mor ོ/ / rje btsun ma yi zhal gyi gdams pa nod/ / zab mo 459

nges don chos kyi mdzod bzung ste/ /khams su bstan pa spel ba'i skyes chen mchog /kun dga' dpal bzang rje la ོ/ / de las bar du slob brgyud rim byon pa/ / nges gsang theg mchog brgyud 'dzin gang bzhugs shing / /zab mo lta ba'i chos la phan rlabs can/ /de dag kun la gus pas ོ/ /khyad par sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i srog shing che/ / mdo sngags chos bka' zab mo'i srol 'dzin pa/ / don gnyis mdzad rab gnang ba'i dam pa rje/ / kun dga' yon tan rgya mtshor ོ/ / nges don mdo sngags rtogs pas thugs bcud rgyas/ /gzhan phan 'phrin las sgo brgya rab yangs pa/ /snyigs dus 'gro mgon zla dang bral ba'i bshes/ /dpal ldan rnam snang rdo rjer ོ/ /de yi brgyud 'dzin zab chos gdams pa'i mdzod/ /rjes 'jug la yang brtse bas legs 'doms pa/ /rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub la mthu mnga' ba'i/ /kun dga' 'od zer zhabs la ོ/ /don dam dkon mchog bstan pa'i bcud brkyang ste/ / nges gsang zab mo'i dgongs pa 'dzin mkhas shing / /gdul bya mtha' yas brten pa'i dpal gyur ba/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog la ོ/ /de yi brgyud 'dzin gang 'dul thabs mkhas pa/ /gzhan phan bzang po mnga' ba'i dam pa rje/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon/ /bka' drin gsum ldan gang la ོ/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi byin brlabs pas/ /zhes pa man chad ltar ro/ /zhes pa'i kha skong 'di yang ma tis so/ /zhes gzhan stong gi bla brgyud 'di yang bswe dgon phyogs rgyal gling du shrī ming gis par du bskrun pa'i dge bar gyur cig /460
